title: Praktikum Gesundheitsförderung und Sporttraining
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Acture Germany
description_html:
Hinweis:

Gerne möchten wir den Praktikumsplatz kurzfristig besetzen. Das Praktikum ist für sechs Monate vorgesehen.


Deine Rolle bei Acture

  • Du bist für die Vorbereitung und Durchführung von Workshops, rund um Themen wie Ergonomie im Arbeitsalltag oder Rückengesundheit verantwortlich und hast dabei direkten Kundenkontakt
  • Reisebereitschaft ist uns wichtig – denn viele Projekte finden direkt beim Kunden statt und sind daher mit kurzen Geschäftsreisen verbunden
  • Dich interessieren verschiedene Trainingsangebote? - Gestalte mit uns Videos und Livestreams 
  • Keine Woche ist wie die andere – aber genau das macht dein Praktikum bei Acture Germany so spannend, vielseitig und lehrreich


Dein Profil

  • Du verfügst über einen Hochschulabschluss (mind. Bachelor) im Bereich Sportwissenschaften oder eine vergleichbare abgeschlossene Ausbildung im Bereich Physiotherapie
  • Du hast Kenntnisse in Microsoft Office, insb. Outlook, Powerpoint, Excel und Word
  • Du bist kommunikativ, offen und fühlst dich bei Präsentationen und Workshops wohl
  • Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, hast eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe und bist motiviert, deinen großen Gestaltungsspielraum zu nutzen
  • Du bist ein Teamplayer, begeistert andere mit deinen Ideen und bist zuverlässig in der Zusammenarbeit
  • Du hast einen Führerschein Klasse B und fühlst dich wohl damit in der Stadt zu fahren und nimmst auch mal eine längere Reise auf dich
  • Du sprichst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau (C2) und fließend Englisch (B2)
Nice to Have
  • Idealerweise hast du eine Weiterbildung im Bereich Bewegungs- oder Entspannungstechniken wie z.B. Fitnesstrainer:in B Lizenz, Yogalehrer:in uvm. 
  • Du hast bereits erste praktische Kenntnisse in einem Unternehmen sammeln können – als Praktikant*in oder Werkstudent*in
  • Du hast schon einmal Workshops vor einer Gruppe angeleitet


Warum wir?

Als Teil des Acture Teams in Deutschland bist du von aufgeschlossenen, smarten Menschen umgeben, die mit Leidenschaft an unserer gemeinsamen Mission arbeiten. Dabei legen wir Wert auf ein gesundes Umfeld zum Arbeiten und Leben, einschließlich flexibler Arbeitszeiten und Home Office.

Neben einer fairen Vergütung profitierst du von zusätzlichen Benefits: 

  • Ein Deutschlandticket als Firmenticket mit einem jährlichen Gegenwert von rund 720 €
  • Eine Firmenfitness-Mitgliedschaft über Urban Sports Club oder Wellpass mit einem jährlichen Mehrwert von rund 600 €

description_html:
Hinweis:

Das Kölner Institut für Managementberatung (KI.M) ist Teil von Acture Germany. Seit vielen Jahren begleiten wir Unternehmen bei Themen rund um Eignungsdiagnostik, Leadership Development sowie Personal- und Organisationsentwicklung. Dabei verbinden wir fachliche Exzellenz mit hoher Kundenorientierung und dem persönlichen Engagement unserer Berater:innen, Trainer:innen und Coaches.

Gleichzeitig beginnt für das KI.M die nächste Wachstumsphase: Neben unserem erfolgreichen Beratungsgeschäft möchten wir neue Potenziale erschließen, unser Geschäftsmodell gezielt weiterentwickeln, digitale und hybride Angebote ausbauen und die Zusammenarbeit innerhalb der Acture Gruppe weiter stärken. 

Für diese Aufgabe suchen wir eine unternehmerisch denkende Führungspersönlichkeit als Managing Director (m/w/d).

Deine Rolle bei Acture

  • Du führst und entwickelst unsere Berater:innen, Trainer:innen und Coaches, gibst ihnen Orientierung und förderst eine Kultur von Vertrauen, Eigenverantwortung und konstruktiv-wertschätzender Zusammenarbeit – innerhalb des KI.M und gemeinsam mit den Kolleg:innen von Acture Germany.
  • Du intensivierst bestehende Kundenbeziehungen, gewinnst neue Kunden und erschließt zusätzliche Wachstumschancen. 
  • Du entwickelst das Leistungsportfolio des KI.M im Kontext des Acture-Portfolios strategisch weiter und setzt Impulse für neue Geschäftsfelder und zukunftsfähige Geschäftsmodelle.
  • Du bringst deine Expertise auch in ausgewählten Projekten und strategisch wichtigen Kundenbeziehungen ein.
  • Du stärkst die Positionierung des KI.M innerhalb der Acture Gruppe sowie am Markt und fungierst als wichtiges Bindeglied zwischen dem KI.M und den Teams von Acture Germany.


Dein Profil

  • Du bringst Erfahrung in der Unternehmens- und/ oder Organisationsberatung mit, idealerweise in Leadership Development, Transformation, Change-Management, Eignungsdiagnostik oder Personalentwicklung und hast vergleichbare Projekte bereits geleitet oder operativ verantwortet.
  • Du verbindest strategische Perspektive mit pragmatischer Umsetzungsstärke und schaffst es, Ideen in nachhaltige Ergebnisse zu überführen.
  • Du hast Erfahrung im Ausbau von Kundenbeziehungen, der Erschließung neuer Geschäftsmöglichkeiten und der Weiterentwicklung von Produkten und Geschäftsfeldern.
  • Du verfügst über exzellente Kommunikations- und Storytelling-Fähigkeiten sowie ein souveränes Auftreten und kannst dich entsprechend auf unterschiedliche Zielgruppen und Stakeholder einstellen. Dadurch bist du in der Lage, andere für deine Ideen und Vorstellungen zu gewinnen und zu begeistern.
  • Du verfügst über Erfahrung oder ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für digitale Geschäftsmodelle, hybride Leistungsangebote und skalierbare Dienstleistungen.
  • Du bist souverän im Umgang mit dynamischen, wachstumsstarken Umfeldern, verfügst über eine hohe Eigenmotivation und eine ausgeprägte Organisationsfähigkeit.
  • Zudem bist du bereit, Termine und Projekte nicht nur online, sondern auch vor Ort wahrzunehmen und bringst die entsprechende Reisebereitschaft mit.
  • Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Studium (Diplom oder Master) in BWL, VWL, Psychologie oder vergleichbar.

title: AI Consultant (all genders) - Hybrid, Berlin/Frankfurt
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Dida
description_html:
Your mission

Bringing ML research into application

dida builds custom machine learning software for industrial and enterprise clients, among them Siemens, Deutsche Bahn, idealo, klöckner.i and Enpal, and has received the Microsoft “AI for Earth Award” for innovative environmental projects, among other recognitions. Our team combines scientific excellence with real business requirements.

Many of our projects start with a concept or evaluation workshop: together with the decision makers we assess use cases and the data situation and turn vague ideas into a concrete project roadmap. We are currently building this workshop format into a consulting offering of its own, and we are looking for reinforcement.

Your role: strategic and technical consulting

As an AI Consultant you are the bridge between our ML scientists and the business units of our clients. You work in tandem with the Account Management and Business Development team and take the technical lead in workshops and pre-sales meetings.

In this position you are the face of dida for specific industries: you follow no rigid process, but develop innovative solutions together with our engineers and our clients.

Your tasks

  • Prepare and run workshops: You prepare client workshops and run them together with the team. Your part is the technical depth: assessing use cases, reviewing the data situation, judging feasibility and translating complex ML concepts into clear business cases.
  • Turn results into roadmaps: You translate workshop results into technical roadmaps and work with our ML teams on effort estimates and proposal content.
  • Work hands-on: You look at client data yourself and build clickable prototypes and small demos that make workshop results tangible right away.
  • Support business development: You bring in technical expertise, for example in discovery calls or on feasibility questions. Commercial responsibility for accounts, offers, pricing and negotiations stays with the sales team.
  • Develop our standards: You extend our workshop frameworks and templates that we reuse with every new client.


Your Profile

  • Education: A strong degree in a quantitative field, for example data science, computer science, mathematics, physics or engineering.
  • Consulting experience: Ideally 2 to 5 years. Big firm or boutique matters less than having worked on projects directly at the client. Exposure to several industries is a plus.
  • Data science and coding: You understand how ML models work and know your way around databases. Practical data science experience and solid coding skills, above all in Python, are a plus.
  • Hands-on mentality: You try things out directly and enjoy building a first prototype quickly.
  • Presence with clients: You enjoy standing in front of clients, moderate discussions confidently and explain technical content in a way that both the business side and IT understand.
  • Languages: Business-fluent German for the DACH market and fluent English for our internal communication.
  • Teamwork: You like working closely with others. Sharing knowledge and giving direct feedback are part of the job for you.

Even if you do not tick every box: we look forward to your application.


Why us?

  • Building something: You help build a young consulting offering from the start and see the effect of your work directly at the client.
  • Team: Close to 40 people from different disciplines with a strong mathematics and physics background, many of them with a PhD.
  • Flexibility: Flexible hours and hybrid work, full-time or part-time.
  • Office: A nice office with good coffee in Berlin-Kreuzberg near Moritzplatz, and in the future in Frankfurt.
  • Short paths: Direct collaboration with the management team.
  • Location: Berlin. Frankfurt am Main is possible by arrangement, many of our clients are based in southern and south-western Germany.


What we need from you?

Please include with your application:

  • CV (required)
  • Degree certificates (required)
  • Transcripts of records, if available
  • Project or code samples (optional)

title: Werkstudent*in Review Management & Feedbackanalyse (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Aok Connect
description_html:
Bewerbungsfrist

Donnerstag, 01. Oktober 2026


So gestaltest du mit

Wir suchen Verstärkung für unser Team im Review Management: Du beantwortest Rezensionen, wertest Nutzer*innenfeedback aus und machst wiederkehrende Anliegen für unser Team sichtbar.

  • Du sichtest regelmäßig Rezensionen und Nutzer*innenfeedback zu unseren digitalen Angeboten, insbesondere zu unseren Apps, kategorisierst sie nachvollziehbar nach Themen, Anliegen und Stimmungslage und erkennst dabei zentrale Muster, wiederkehrende Hinweise und akute Auffälligkeiten.
  • Du formulierst, prüfst und finalisierst Antworten auf Rezensionen – wertschätzend, verständlich, adressatengerecht und im Rahmen abgestimmter Kommunikationsleitlinien.
  • Du bereitest zentrale Erkenntnisse aus der Auswertung regelmäßig in kurzen Übersichten, Tabellen oder Reports auf und dokumentierst sie so, dass sie für Kommunikation, Support und Produktentwicklung nutzbar werden.
  • Mit wachsender Erfahrung unterstützt du dabei, Antwortbausteine, Kategorien, Auswertungslogiken und Arbeitsabläufe im Review Management weiterzuentwickeln.
  • Du bringst Ideen ein, wie digitale Werkzeuge und KI sinnvoll bei Kategorisierung, Antwortentwürfen, Zusammenfassungen und Reporting unterstützen können und prüfst Ergebnisse sorgfältig auf Qualität und Verständlichkeit.


Das bringst du mit

  • Du bist eingeschriebene*r Student*in an einer Hochschule oder Fachhochschule, idealerweise in den Fachrichtungen Kommunikationswissenschaft, Medien-, Sozial- oder Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Psychologie, Digital Health oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang, und hast mindestens das dritte Semester erfolgreich abgeschlossen.
  • Du schreibst sehr sicher und stilsicher auf Deutsch und hast ein sehr gutes Gespür für Sprache, Tonalität und adressatengerechte Kommunikation.
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, sorgfältig und eigenständig und verbindest kommunikative Stärke mit analytischem Denken – du kannst Rückmeldungen nicht nur beantworten, sondern auch auswerten, einordnen und verständlich zusammenfassen. 
  • Du hast gute Excel-Kenntnisse.
  • Du bist technisch aufgeschlossen, arbeitest dich gern in neue Tools ein und interessierst dich für den sinnvollen Einsatz von KI und Automatisierung im Arbeitsalltag.
  • Idealerweise hast du bereits erste Erfahrungen in Kommunikation, Kundenservice, Community Management oder in der Arbeit mit digitalen Produkten gesammelt.

Du musst nicht alle Punkte vollständig erfüllen – wichtig sind uns vor allem ein gutes Gespür für Sprache und Zielgruppe sowie analytisches Denken.


Das erwartet dich bei uns

  • Wir bieten eine zukunftssichere Tätigkeit bei einem jungen Unternehmen, das für die 27 Mio. Versicherten der AOK die Umsetzung wirksamer digitaler Dienste (wie z.B. der elektronischen Patientenakte) sicherstellt und dabei nachhaltig die Digitalisierung im Gesundheitswesen vorantreibt.
  • Dazu gibt es eine attraktive Vergütung mit einem Stundenlohn von 18,00 € brutto bei ca. 20 Stunden pro Woche.
  • Wir bieten dir flexible Arbeitsmöglichkeiten, die sich gut mit deinem Studium vereinbaren lassen. In Rücksprache mit deinem Team arbeitest du in unserem modernen Büro in zentraler Lage in Berlin oder mobil. Darüber hinaus kommt die ganze Organisation einmal monatlich in Präsenz an unserem Berliner Standort zusammen.
  • Wir bieten flexible Arbeitszeiten, die mit einem Jahresarbeitszeitkonto an deine jeweiligen Bedürfnisse angepasst werden können, sowie ein anteiliger Urlaubsanspruch auf Basis von 30 Urlaubstagen bei einer 5-Tage-Woche.


Du hast noch Fragen?

  • Bei Rückfragen zur Ausschreibung oder dem Bewerbungsprozess stehen wir dir gerne zur Verfügung.
  • Wende dich für Anfragen bitte direkt per Mail an
  • Deine Bewerbungsunterlagen (Anschreiben und Lebenslauf) kannst du direkt über den unten stehenden Button "Auf diese Stelle bewerben" über unser Bewerbungsportal einsenden.
  • Alternativ übermittle diese per E-Mail an Datenschutzerklärung zustimmst.


Was du sonst noch wissen solltest

  • Wir stehen für den Inklusionsgedanken. Wir unterstützen daher ausdrücklich Bewerbungen von Menschen mit Schwerbehinderung. Diese werden bei gleicher Eignung und Befähigung bevorzugt berücksichtigt. Unser Unternehmen fördert zudem aktiv die Gleichberechtigung und hat sich zum Ziel gesetzt, die berufliche Entwicklung von Frauen zu unterstützen.

title: Logistics Manager - Retail & D2C (m/f/d)
description_html:
About HOLY

  • HOLY is the soft drink revolution: With our product lines Energy®, Iced Tea®, Hydration®, Milkshake®, and our newest innovation, the HOLY Syrup Bottle® you get amazing taste across 50+ flavors while maintaining a good conscience—for your body & the environment.
  • Over 2M loyal customers: Started in a shared apartment by three best friends, we have scaled to Europe's fastest growing consumer brand—and our cult-like community, the HOLY Squad, loves it: 4.6 stars on reviews.io speak for themselves.
  • From D2C to Global Omnichannel: In less than four years, we've profitably scaled HOLY to more than €180M D2C revenue in DACH, FR, UK and PL. Now scaling our retail business, we're on an exciting transition to becoming a true omnichannel rocketship.
  • We are still just getting started: Backed by the world's best consumer investors, we aim to revolutionize the soft drink industry and build a generational love brand: tastier, healthier & more sustainable. Our team of 170+ people aims high (Coca-Cola, we're coming for you!).


About the Position

HOLY is growing fast: with new product launches, expanding retail partnerships, and an ever-increasing customer base driving demand across all channels.

To keep pace with this momentum, we are looking for a Logistics Manager with a clear focus on Retail and a strong connection to D2C Logistics. You will make sure that retail orders are prepared completely and delivered on time, while also supporting reliable D2C fulfillment, inventory flow, and customer experience.

This role is highly operational and hands-on. You are the kind of person who spots a problem, takes ownership, and fixes it before it becomes a bigger issue.

Retail Logistics Ownership

  • Take end-to-end responsibility for ensuring that retail orders are complete and ready for shipment on time.
  • Own Retail OTIF performance and proactively steer against deviations with fulfillment partners and retail customers.
  • Coordinate display assembly, capacity planning, timelines, and escalations.

D2C Logistics Support
  • Support reliable D2C order fulfillment, inventory flow, replenishment, and delivery performance.
  • Monitor open operational issues and coordinate quick resolutions with fulfillment partners, Supply Chain, Customer Service, and E-Commerce.
  • Support accurate system synchronization across warehouses and sales channels.

3PL Partnership & Operations Oversight
  • Act as an operational contact for our fulfillment partners across Retail and D2C topics.
  • Ensure SLA adherence and daily operational stability.
  • Escalate and resolve deviations in speed, accuracy, availability, or cost efficiency swiftly.

Performance Analysis & Reporting
  • Track retail and D2C logistics KPIs and turn them into actionable insights.
  • Use partner reports and internal dashboards to identify risks, recurring issues, and improvement opportunities.
  • Maintain clear SOPs, documentation, and performance reporting for internal visibility.
Cross-Functional Coordination
  • Act as the communication bridge between Logistics, Inside Sales, Retail, E-Commerce, Customer Service, Supply Chain, and external partners.
  • Keep stakeholders informed of critical operational updates, risks, and changes.
  • Lead root-cause investigations and coordinate quick resolutions to protect customer experience.
Process Improvement & Scalability
  • Improve recurring logistics workflows across Retail and D2C.
  • Identify efficiency and cost-reduction opportunities and track implementation progress.
  • Help build scalable logistics playbooks for HOLY's omnichannel growth.


About You

  • Retail-Ops-Ownership: You take full end-to-end responsibility for retail order readiness and OTIF performance, proactively steering against deviations before they become escalations.
  • 3PL & partner management: Proven experience managing fulfillment partners operationally - holding them to SLAs, resolving deviations in speed, accuracy or cost quickly and calmly.
  • Cross-functional coordination: Comfortable acting as the bridge between Logistics, Retail, E-Commerce, Customer Service and Supply Chain, keeping stakeholders aligned even when things move fast.
  • Analytical & KPI-driven: Skilled at turning partner reports and internal dashboards into actionable insights, spotting risks and recurring issues early.
  • Language proficiency: Fluency in English and German is a must.


Our Offering

In today's job market, A-players have many options to choose from. As part of our offer, we prioritise providing a productive working environment and opportunities for growth. In addition to competitive compensation, including company shares, you can expect:

  • A successful and growing company: Join a company that has been growing profitable and quickly for the last 36+ months and have just raised a series B, while many other e-commerce companies are struggling.
  • Huge impact: Enjoy huge impact to shape HOLY’s internationalisation in a top market.
  • Awesome team: Join an awesome team of colleagues who are ambitious, funny, down-to-earth, and authentic. Get to know us and see for yourself!
  • Top product: Marketing is important, but a good product is essential. Our differentiated soft drinks have won over customers. Check out our reviews.io reviews or contact us for free samples.
  • Startup culture: Join a startup culture that values flat hierarchies, fast pace, and personal development. With us, you can make a real impact.
  • Perfect setup: Enjoy a perfect setup that includes all the requirements of a modern employer, such as a central office in Berlin Prenzlauerberg, flexible working hours, and much more.
  • Competitive comp. + equity: Join us at a pivotal stage of hypergrowth. We offer a strong salary and meaningful equity—giving you the chance to share in our current success and benefit from the massive upside as we scale.
Find out more about HOLY and our team on our careers page.


The Process

As we are experiencing rapid growth and have ambitious plans, the optimal start date for the position is today. Nonetheless, we are prepared to patiently await the arrival of the ideal candidate, recognizing that quality ultimately yields the best results.

  1. Getting to know you: After reviewing your CV, Eric, our Talent Acquisition Manager, will have a 30-minute screening interview with you to discuss more about HOLY and the position and see if our expectations match.

description_html:
GUARDSPHERE
Saarbrücken, Germany | On-site | Co-Founder / Equity | Deep Tech / OT & Industrial Cybersecurity

About GuardSphere
GuardSphere protects factories, energy plants and critical infrastructure from cyberattacks without ever stopping production. Its product, NeuroX Shield, passively watches a plant's industrial network, learns normal behavior, and lets operators respond to threats safely and gradually — built for mid-sized German manufacturers and utilities who can't afford downtime and have no in-house security specialist.

**The opportunity
**Founded around Farah Elshenawy (7 years in penetration testing, OSCP, MSc Entrepreneurial Cybersecurity at Saarland University/CISPA) and machine-learning lead Nazligul Kese, GuardSphere has validated its prototype with 47+ industry professionals across 6 industrial events and secured €800k in StartupSecure funding. What's missing is the commercial engine to turn validated R&D into revenue. We are looking for a Business / Industry co-founder specialized in OT security go-to-market, GuardSphere is separately also open to a CTO / software co-founder with OT/ICS development experience.

Tasks

What you will own

**Go-to-market & sales
**- Build GuardSphere's route into German manufacturing and utilities, converting strong customer interest (47+ contacts across 6 events) into pilots and paying customers.
- Bridge NeuroX Shield's technical capabilities with the budget and risk-appetite decision cycle of Plant Managers and CISOs.
Commercial strategy
- Understand and navigate industrial procurement processes, budgets and buying decisions in OT/manufacturing.
- Own pricing, packaging and commercial positioning as the prototype becomes a repeatable product.
Company build-up
- Lead incorporation (planned mid-2027) and support fundraising alongside Farah Elshenawy (Project Lead / CEO track).

Requirements

What you bring

**Core experience
**- Business development or sales experience in OT/ICS cybersecurity, industrial automation, or a closely related B2B industrial technology field.
- Understanding of German manufacturing and utilities procurement, budgets and decision cycles.
Especially valuable
- Existing network among Plant Managers, CISOs or OT security buyers.
- Familiarity with IEC 62443 and industrial compliance standards.
- GuardSphere is separately seeking a CTO/Developer co-founder, hands-on OT/ICS software development experience is valuable for that parallel track.

Benefits

Why join GuardSphere
- A prototype already validated through 47+ customer conversations and 6 industrial events, real market pull, not just a hypothesis.
- €800k in non-dilutive StartupSecure funding already secured.
- Ground-floor equity in a company addressing a growing, regulation-driven market (IEC 62443, rising OT/ICS attack surface).

GuardSphere welcomes co-founder candidates regardless of gender, age, ethnic origin, religion or belief, disability, sexual identity, or any other characteristic. This is a search for the right partner to build the company with, not a conventional hire.

title: Staff Backend Engineer, Integrations
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Vibe
description_html:
Streaming TV is no longer just a brand awareness channel. It’s becoming a core part of the performance marketing mix, alongside search and social. Vibe.co is building the platform that makes TV work like the rest of the acquisition stack: targeted, measurable, and optimized for results.

Vibe.co is an Audience First Streaming TV Advertising platform that gives marketers the tools to reach the right audiences, optimize campaigns in real time, and understand what’s actually driving business outcomes. With hyper-targeted segmentation, AI-powered recommendations, real-time optimization, and incrementality measurement, Vibe brings the precision and accountability of digital advertising to the biggest screen in the house.

Today, more than 12,000 brands use Vibe.co to reach 120 million+ households. And in August 2026, Vibe.co became a Walmart company, opening up a new chapter for the business and the industry. With Walmart’s first-party data and purchase signals now part of the Vibe platform, advertisers can connect TV advertising to real-world transactions and measure the impact of CTV with a level of precision previously associated with platforms like Google and Meta.

This is a unique moment to join Vibe. With Walmart’s scale, data, and reach behind us, we’re building the next generation of TV advertising and creating a more measurable, performance-driven future for the channel.

About the Role

You'll join the Integrations team, the connective tissue of Vibe's platform, reporting to the Engineering Manager. The team owns everything flowing in and out of Vibe: measurement and attribution integrations, audience connections from CRMs and CDPs, and reporting pipelines.

This role exists because we're building a first-class Developer Platform: opening Vibe's full capabilities as a public API so external partners can build on top of us. Criteo is the first partner live on it.

Three reasons to want this:

  • You'll be one of the most senior engineers on Integrations, setting technical direction for a team that's still small enough for one person's decisions to shape it

  • You'll own the foundational architecture for a platform external partners are already building against

  • AI-augmented development is the expectation here, not the experiment

What You'll Do

Build and ship integrations

  • Design and implement production-grade integrations with external platforms: CRMs, CDPs, measurement vendors, data partners

  • Own integration projects end to end, from scoping through production, with full accountability for outcomes

  • Work directly with external partners to define, validate, and evolve data contracts

Developer Platform

  • Drive the architecture of Vibe's public API: account, advertiser, and campaign management endpoints built to scale

  • Build the documentation, monitoring, and tooling that makes the developer experience genuinely good

  • Contribute to the MCP gateway and authentication layers that expose Vibe's capabilities externally

Reliability and scale

  • Find the weak points in existing pipelines and lead the rebuild

  • Set the standard for code quality on the team: your reviews move the bar, not just the diff

  • Use AI tooling to accelerate your own output and raise the team's

Technical leadership

  • Set engineering norms and technical direction as the Integrations team grows

  • Weigh in on architecture decisions across the team, not just your own projects

  • Partner with the Engineering Manager on technical direction and hiring calibration

What You Need

  • 8+ years building production backend systems: APIs, data pipelines, distributed services at scale

  • Strong TypeScript backend experience

  • Direct ownership of a major project, start to finish, not just a contributor role on someone else's

  • AWS and Terraform experience, with real architectural decision-making, not just implementation

  • A high-ownership background: startup, scale-up, or anywhere you couldn't hand the hard problems to someone else

Nice to Haves

  • Third-party integrations experience: ETL, webhooks, REST/GraphQL APIs

  • Python/C++/Rust, alongside your TS work

  • Experience designing or contributing to developer-facing platforms or public APIs

  • Startup experience (~300 people or fewer), current or past. Doesn't need to be your most recent role

Our Values

At Vibe, we run on three values: Impact, Ambition, and Urgency. We tie every goal to a real business outcome, think 10x rather than settling for good enough, and move daily rather than waiting for perfect conditions.

You'll thrive here if you own outcomes without needing direction, default to action, and hold yourself to results, not effort.

This is a high-performance environment with high-performance rewards: you'll work alongside people who push you, with real ownership over hard problems in a market that's moving fast.

If that sounds like the best version of your career, we want to meet you.

What We Offer

At Vibe, we want you to build something, own something, and grow fast. Here's how we back that up:

Location: Paris - the pay range for this role is €88,000–€120,000.

  • Variable pay based on objectives you hit. No arbitrary targets.

  • Hybrid flexibility. We're in the heart of Paris and our team is in 3x a week.

  • Health insurance. Full coverage via Alan.

  • Meal vouchers via Swile.

  • Annual offsite. The whole team, once a year, somewhere worth the trip.

  • Tech Syncs. Engineering and Product meet in person at least quarterly, worldwide.

Our Interview Process

We respect your time. Here's exactly what to expect: no surprises, no ghosting.

  1. Recruiter screen. 30 min. We'll share context; you'll share yours.

  2. Manager Interview. 45 min with your future manager. Your experience, your projects, your approach.

  3. Product Interview. 30 mins with the Product Manager for this team. We want to hear about how you've worked cross-functionally in previous roles.

  4. Technical assessment. 90 min. Code review exercise plus applied questions, including how you use AI in your workflow. Real problems, not tricks.

  5. Bar raiser. 30 min with a senior leader to ensure we're holding a consistent, high bar.

  6. Offer. Fast. We don't let good decisions sit.

Equal Opportunity

Vibe is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

We believe the best ideas come from teams with different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know.

Referral Instructions

Being referred? Ask your contact to submit your application directly on your behalf.

  • Harden security across our cloud native ecosystem (AWS and GCP) and third-party providers.

  • Own access management from onboarding to offboarding, and get it to the point where it runs without you.

Detection & Response

  • Prioritize vulnerability findings by real exposure, assign them to the team that owns the code, and follow remediation through to closure.

  • Own security incident response from detection through resolution.

  • Turn manual processes into pipelines that run on their own.

  • Launch and run Vibe's private bug bounty program.

Trust & Compliance

  • Own SOC 2 compliance end to end and maintain current certification.

  • Drive Vibe's future compliance initiatives and requirements.

  • Define Vibe's security posture and make it self-serve so enterprise deals clear security without routing through you.

Security Culture

  • Set clear, practical rules for safe AI use, built into the tools themselves, covering both the AI we ship in our products and the AI our teams work with every day.

  • Run security awareness training and measure behavior changes so the whole company raises its bar.

What You Need

  • Built a security function as a company's first security hire.

  • Write code comfortably and bring deep cloud-native security experience.

  • Managed a compliance framework at scale, such as SOC 2, ISO 27001 or HIPAA.

  • Managed AI security risk hands on, both in what a company ships with AI and in how its employees use it day to day.

Nice to Haves

  • Ran a private bug bounty program.

  • Ad tech security background, including exposure to US privacy law (CCPA/CPRA, VPPA) in a data-heavy environment.

title: CENTRALE LYON - PhD Silicon Photonics for Scalable Energy-Efficient AI Hardware Accelerators
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at CENTRALE LYON
description_html:
The rapid expansion of artificial intelligence (AI) applications across cloud and edge environments is driving the need for highly efficient hardware capable of supporting increasingly demanding workloads. Among these, matrix multiplication – particularly General Matrix Multiplication (GEMM) – remains the dominant computational kernel in modern AI models, including deep neural networks and transformer architectures. Conventional electronic accelerators, while highly optimized, face growing challenges related to energy consumption, data movement, and scalability.

Silicon photonics has emerged as a promising technology to address these limitations by enabling highbandwidth, low-latency, and potentially energy-efficient computation through optical signal processing. In particular, recent advances in photonic computing leveraging phase-change materials (PCM) offer new opportunities for implementing reconfigurable and non-volatile computational primitives directly in the optical domain.

This PhD is part of the CAMELIA program (ASIC and Numérique agencies) within the targeted project LEAF, and aims to explore a hybrid photonic–electronic computing paradigm for AI acceleration. The central objective is to design and evaluate silicon photonics-based architectures for efficient GEMM operations, building on recent work demonstrating a reconfigurable photonic GEMM architecture based on PCM and stochastic computing.

The proposed research will focus on extending this tile-based photonic GEMM approach toward large-scale matrix operations under realistic conditions. Key challenges include managing PCM-related constraints such as limited precision and quantization effects, mitigating noise and variability, and addressing interface latency between photonic and electronic domains.

A major aspect of the PhD will be the development of system-level evaluation and benchmarking methodologies within a design-technology co-optimization (DTCO/SDTCO) framework. The objective is to provide quantitative and objective metrics for decision-making, including scalability analysis, computational throughput, and energy efficiency for target AI workloads. These evaluations will support both intermediate design exploration and the potential experimental validation of fabricated demonstrators within the broader program.

In addition, the PhD will address electronic circuit design challenges associated with photonic accelerators, including interface circuits for control, programming of PCM elements, optical-to-electrical readout, and signal conversion. These aspects are critical for ensuring the practical integration of photonic computing units within heterogeneous AI hardware systems.

The expected outcome is a set of novel architectures, models, and evaluation tools that will clarify the potential and limitations of silicon photonics for next-generation AI accelerators, and provide guidelines for scalable and energy-efficient implementations.


Background: The candidate should hold or be about to obtain an MSc in Electronics Engineering, Photonics, or Computer Engineering. A strong background in computer architecture, integrated circuits, or photonic systems is expected. Knowledge of AI hardware accelerators, in-memory computing, or silicon photonics will be appreciated.

Environment: The PhD will be carried out at the INL laboratory, within the CAMELIA program, as part of the LEAF project, in collaboration between leading academic and institutional partners in AI hardware and photonics.

Starting dates: Fall 2026

At Excelya, where Audacity, Care, and Energy are at the core of everything we do, we are seeking a Senior CMC Regulatory Consultant specializing in small molecules lifecycle management to join our dynamic team.

Excelling with care means benefiting from an environment that values your natural talents, pushes boundaries with audacity, and nurtures your potential, allowing you to contribute fully to our shared mission.

title: Finance & AI Automation Intern (Remote Part-time)
salary_basis: Based on historical internship stipend records at Soda Data Nv
description_html:
Data quality is the bottleneck of the AI era. Every Fortune 500 is trying to solve it. We're the team they call.

Soda is the data quality layer for Disney, Ralph Lauren, CBRE, HelloFresh, 2K Games, and Nubank. The category is growing rapidly because AI doesn't work on bad data. Behind the product sits a group of three companies in two currencies, and a small finance team that keeps all of it correct. We're hiring a Finance & AI Automation Intern to run core finance processes and automate the manual work out of them.

About Us

Soda's mission is to monitor the world's decisions. We're building the first Data & AI performance monitoring platform that spans data collection to automated decision-making. Soda helps customers find, understand, and fix data quality issues by combining automated post-production monitoring with pre-production pipeline data testing.

Soda was founded in 2019 by Maarten (employee #5 at Collibra) and Tom (creator of multiple open-source projects generating hundreds of millions in value). We commercialize through Soda Cloud and we're well-funded, with investors like Point 9 Capital, Hummingbird, Singular, and Eurazeo.

The Role

You'll join the Finance team that covers Soda Data NV (Belgium), Soda Data Inc. (US) and NannyML NV, the Belgian company we acquired in 2025. The work is real from week one: invoice processing, month-end reporting, payroll data preparation, expense management, and intercompany recharges across three entities, two currencies and three accounting systems.

The second half of the job is making that work disappear. Finance at Soda builds agentically: Claude and other AI tools are part of the daily workflow, not an experiment on the side. You'll learn a process, run it until you know it cold, and then automate it. Sometimes that means an AI agent on GitHub, sometimes a well-designed formula - you pick the right tool and defend the choice. Accuracy is the bar for both: in finance, 99% right is wrong, so every automation ships with the checks and reconciliations that prove its output.

What You'll Do

  • Run core finance processes: invoice processing, month-end reporting, payroll data preparation, expense management, and intercompany recharges. Learn them, run them, own them.
  • Automate them: with Claude, ChatGPT, GitHub and the Soda MCP, or with smart spreadsheet design when that is the better tool.
  • Build in the checks: reconciliations and controls in everything you automate, so the output is verified before anyone else has to look at it.
  • Document as you go: process documentation that a colleague and an AI agent can both follow.
  • Support the wider Finance team: reporting, analysis, and ad-hoc projects across our Belgian and US entities.

Hiring Process

1.      Application with a few short questions

2.      Recorded video interview (3 questions, in your own time)

3.      20-minute interview

4.      Take-home assignment (plan for 5-6 hours)

5.      45-minute deep dive on your assignment

6.      Final interview

We answer every application, and every candidate hears back within 3-5 days of each step. If it's not a hell yes, it's a no, and we'll tell you quickly and kindly.

Requirements

•     A finance background: studying towards or recently completed a degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related field.

•     Proof that you build: you've used AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) and/or built automations, scripts, or advanced spreadsheet solutions, and you can show us one and explain how you checked its output.

•     Accuracy as a habit: you're the person who notices the 780 that should have been 800, and you don't sign off on numbers you haven't verified.

•     Independent with new tools: you can pick up GitHub, MCP-based integrations, and finance systems without a course.

•     Proactive: you spot the manual work and come with a plan for it. You'd rather build the workflow than do the task fifteen more times.

•     Fluent English, written and spoken.

•     European business hours: fully remote from any compatible time zone, or hybrid if you're near Amsterdam.

Good to Have

•     Experience with accounting software (e.g. Exact Online, QuickBooks) or ERP systems.

•     Exposure to Python, SQL, or API-based automation.

•     Prior startup or fast-paced work experience.

Benefits

What We Offer

•     €1,250 - €1,750 per month, depending on experience.

•     A clear path to a permanent role if you perform: 3-month contractor engagement first, extended as it works.

•     Fully remote and flexible working, or hybrid if you're near Amsterdam.

•     All the tokens you need, across all frontier models.

•     Real ownership, real impact, no micromanagement. This is not a coffee-and-observe internship - you operate as part of the Finance team.

•     Start: As soon as possible, aiming for the beginning of October 2026

Our Values

We value freedom with responsibility, transparency, and a growth mindset. We avoid politics, have no tolerance for dishonesty, and value open and direct communication without judgment. We proactively bring up and address potential issues before they become critical, and we overcommunicate frequently. Working at Soda, you will have full autonomy to make impactful product and roadmap decisions.

❤️ Why you will love to join Soda

•     You own processes, not tickets: what you automate is yours to design, and behind it is a list of things nobody here has built yet.

•     Be part of a transformation: data quality is having its moment, and we're at the front of it.

•     Ownership from day one: if you see a bottleneck, you remove it.

•     International culture: colleagues in 12+ countries.

•     Work on your own terms: fully remote, flexible hours.

😡 What you might not love

•     Rapidly changing priorities: our roadmap can pivot quickly. It's a fast-paced environment with a LOT of work to be done.

•     Flexibility required: you will have to learn new things all the time.

 

Join us to elevate our finance team to the next level!

description_html:
Chez Withings, nous pensons qu’il est temps de redonner aux individus le contrôle de leur santé.

Nous avons l’obsession de créer des produits beaux et au design non intrusif, afin que chacun puisse les utiliser facilement dans son quotidien ; nos balances connectées, nos montres hybrides, nos tensiomètres et nos moniteurs de sommeil sont aujourd’hui utilisés par des millions d’utilisateurs.

Notre objectif à moyen terme ? Permettre la prévention, le dépistage et l’accompagnement d’un certains nombre de maladies chroniques via des produits et des services innovants, afin de révolutionner la manière dont on prend soin de notre santé.

Vos missions

Sous la responsabilité du directeur commercial, vous serez en charge de la définition et de l’exécution de la stratégie commerciale sur un ou plusieurs marchés internationaux.

Intégré.e au sein de l’équipe Sales B2C, vous aurez les responsabilités suivantes :

  • Développer et manager les réseaux de distribution sur la région qui vous sera confiée.
  • Identifier, ouvrir et développer les comptes retail & online.
  • Accroître la part de marché chez les clients actuels.
  • Construire les business plans avec vos clients afin d’atteindre les objectifs ambitieux de croissance.
  • Être garant.e du pricing et des négociations annuelles.
  • Élaborer et coordonner les initiatives marketing avec l’équipe dédiée.
  • Collaborer avec les différentes équipes en interne pour atteindre vos objectifs (Notamment ADV, Finance, Produit, Légal et Marketing)

Requirements

  • De formation Bac+5 de type école de commerce ou équivalent, vous possédez une première expérience commerciale et/ou channel marketing réussie dans un environnement international. Des connaissances en distribution de produits électroniques grand public sont un plus.
  • Vous avez un sens aigu des affaires, une forte aisance commerciale et une vraie orientation résultats.
  • Vous avez une vraie affinité avec les chiffres et savez en tirer des recommandations stratégiques.
  • Vous êtes capable de travailler dans un environnement changeant et sous pression qui requiert une grande autonomie.
  • Vous êtes rigoureux.se, organisé.e, polyvalent.e et proactif.ve.
  • Vous avez un grand sens de la communication en français et en anglais, aussi bien à l’écrit qu’à l’oral.
  • Vous êtes exigeant.e dans votre travail et ne laissez rien passer tout en étant autonome.

Le poste basé au siège d’Issy-les-Moulineaux, des déplacements fréquents sont à prévoir.

Benefits

Rejoindre l’aventure Withings, c’est :

  • Intégrer un des pionniers et leaders mondiaux de la santé connectée, plusieurs fois primé au Consumer Electronic Show
  • Contribuer à des projets innovants et ambitieux pour la santé de demain dans un environnement agile et en constante évolution
  • Intégrer une entreprise internationale, membre de la FrenchTech 120, dont les équipes sont basées à Issy-les-Moulineaux, Boston, Hong-Kong et Shenzhen
  • Participer à l’amélioration continue de nos produits et services en les bêta-testant avant leur sortie, notamment lors de nos nombreuses sessions sportives entre collègues
  • Bénéficier de nombreux avantages : Stock Options, smartphone et ordinateur de votre choix, réductions pour des activités culturelles et sportives, restaurant d’entreprise, et bien plus encore
  • Participer à la Withings Med Academy en assistant à des conférences de professionnels de santé afin de renforcer ses connaissances dans le domaine médical
  • Collaborer avec des collègues passionnés et célébrer ensemble chacune de nos réussites !


Toutes les candidatures reçues sont étudiées indépendamment de l’origine ethnique, des opinions, des croyances, de la religion, du genre, de l’orientation sexuelle ou de la santé des candidats. Withings aspire à offrir et garantir l’égalité des chances aux candidats et seules les personnes habilitées (RH et Management) auront accès aux informations concernant votre candidature.

title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager
description_html:
At Semperis, our mission is to be a Force for Good. Starting with being a great place to work. We believe that when people feel valued, supported, and empowered, they do their best work. That’s why we focus on creating an employee experience rooted in purpose, growth, and balance. Semperis has been recognized as one of America’s Fastest-Growing Cybersecurity Companies by the Inc. 5000, a DUNS 100 Top Startup to Work For, and a multi-year Inc. Best Workplace awardee.

What we are looking for:

Semperis is looking for a passionate and results-driven Enterprise Customer Success Manager to join our EMEA team.

What you will be doing:

As an Enterprise Customer Success Manager at Semperis, you will ensure your customers' success and satisfaction with our products and support them every step of the way. You will be an essential member of our Customer Success team, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams including Technical Delivery and Sales teams to maximise opportunities for our Enterprise Business customers and Semperis.

Our Customer Success Managers are strategic and empathetic communicators who can convey complex concepts in a clear and concise manner. Our CSM will build and nurture long-lasting relationships across multiple client accounts. Our CSM’s strengths include the ability to identify gaps in the product and internal operations and build effective and scalable solutions to address them. Our CSM will also onboard new customers, ensuring a smooth and successful implementation of our solutions.

You will be responsible for:

  • Designing success plans for a Book of Business of strategic customers throughout their lifecycle. From onboarding and implementation through upsell, cross-sell, and renewal, you will guide your customer down the path of success every step of the way to reach their business objectives and operational goals

  • You will be empowered to achieve and report on customer health, satisfaction, retention, and growth targets

  • Act as the voice of the customer, gather insights to provide feedback to internal teams including our Product Development team. Collaborate on new developments to ensure the product suits our client’s needs

  • Leading training sessions to ensure that the product is meeting user needs and is being used widely enough to have concrete impact on our customers' operations

  • Monitoring record-keeping to ensure that relevant customer information is captured to enable informed, personalised customer interactions with Semperis Support, Customer Success (CS), Sales, etc

  • Developing and execute programs for ongoing customer development (health checks, product upgrades, workshops, etc.)

  • Identifying potential customer references and assist with development of customer case studies

  • Gaining and maintain an understanding of Semperis technology, products, and services

  • In addition to managing an assigned customer segment, assist with development and enhancement of processes and systems for the overall Semperis CS program

What you will bring to the table:

Technical & Cyber Security Skills

  • Hands-on product enablement experience with a security product vendor, including running product health checks, articulating the output with expertise, configuring or tuning alert and response rules, remediating Active Directory and Entra security posture vulnerabilities

  • Understanding of security concepts (NIST IR process, MITRE Attack framework, APTs, etc.) and workflows, Active Directory and Entra ID vulnerabilities and attack patterns, IAM and Security team organisation structures

Strong foundational knowledge of cyber security domains:

  • Network security, endpoint protection (EDR/XDR), cloud security (CSPM/CWPP), identity (IAM/SSO/MFA), SIEM, zero-trust, threat intelligence, etc

  • Fundamental understanding of modern architectures: on-prem and cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP)

  • Familiarity with compliance frameworks (NIST CSF, CIS, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, HIPAA, GDPR, SOC 2)

Customer-facing & Soft Skills -

  • 5+ years’ experience as a Customer Success Manager, technical account manager, or related customer-facing role in a Cybersecurity SaaS solutions company

  • Executive presence & communication: can explain complex threats or product value to CISOs, CIOs, architects, and analysts in their language

  • Storytelling with data: Turn telemetry, risk scores, and attack surface metrics into compelling business narratives

  • Project/program management: Be in tune with customer onboarding, health checks, maturity roadmaps, and expansion opportunities

  • Conflict resolution & expectation management during incidents or escalations

  • Consultative selling & value realisation: Identify use cases that justify expansion, upsell & cross-sell modules, or multi-year renewals

Business & Strategic Skills -

  • Renewal & expansion forecasting (understand ARR, NRR, consumption metrics)

  • Ability to build and Execute Customer Success Plans / Joint Success Plans with Account owners (sales reps)

  • Risk identification (technical debt, low adoption, competing solutions) and mitigation planning (QBRs, escalation paths)

  • Competitive intelligence: Know how your product differentiates from the competition

Preferences:

  • Experience with SFDC and Active Directory

  • Fluent English language skills are required

  • German language proficiency would be a strong advantage

#LI-LP1

Why Join Semperis?
You’ll be part of a global team on the front lines of cybersecurity innovation. At Semperis, we celebrate curiosity, integrity, and people who take initiative. If you’re someone who sees the glass as half full, embraces challenges as growth opportunities, and values a healthy balance between work and life—we’d love to meet you.

**Semperis maintains office locations in several cities across the globe. Where the job description specifies a required location, candidates will follow our hybrid work model. This includes working up to three days per week and remotely the remaining days.

Semperis is an equal opportunity employer and will not discriminate against an applicant or employee based on race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), age, physical or mental disability, veteran or military status, genetic information, citizenship, marital status, or any other legally recognized protected basis under federal, state, or local law. The information collected by the Semperis application is solely to determine suitability for employment, verify identity, and maintain employment statistics.

Applicants with disabilities may be entitled to reasonable accommodation under the Americans with Disabilities Act and/or other applicable state or local laws. A reasonable accommodation is a change in the way things are normally done which will ensure an equal employment opportunity without imposing undue hardship on Semperis. Please inform Semperis representative Anna Taylor, Director of Global Recruiting, if you need assistance completing this application or to otherwise participate in the application process.

title: Cloud Solution Architect - Educational Content Author, Nebius Academy
description_html:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The Role

Nebius is seeking a Middle AI Solution Architect to drive adoption of our high-performance cloud infrastructure by creating educational content. You’ll join our Nebius Academy team with a mission to help developers succeed with Nebius’ cloud offerings. In this role, you’ll focus on communicating technical capabilities and showcasing differences across Nebius products: cloud infrastructure services and Token Factory.

This unique role combines some responsibilities of an AI Solution Architect and an Educational Content Author, allowing you to develop skills and grow in different directions as a Solution Architect and/or Developer Advocate while working together with an amazing team of Nebius AI Engineers and Solution Architects.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Educational content creation
    • Create technical content demonstrating how to effectively use computing workloads with VMs, GPU clusters, k8s, SLURM, Soperator, etc.
    • Develop sample code, tutorials, and reference architectures showcasing best practices for cloud computing and ML infrastructure
    • Create video tutorials and live coding sessions demonstrating effective use of Nebius cloud infrastructure
  • Helping Academy's partners build cloud solutions
    • Collaborate with academic partners (universities, e.g., Stevens, MIT) to understand their requirements and develop solution architectures that align with their needs: design and document Infrastructure as Code solutions, documentation, and technical how-to guides in collaboration with the Nebius Solutions Architect Team
    • Act as a trusted advisor to our academic partners, providing technical expertise on GPU cloud technologies and best practices

We expect you to have:

Technical knowledge and skills

  • Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure and distributed computing principles
  • Experience with virtual machines, containerization, and managing compute resources
  • Experience building with IaC solutions, preferably Terraform
  • Knowledge of GPU clusters and techniques for optimizing ML workloads
  • Working knowledge of container orchestration systems like Kubernetes and job schedulers like SLURM
  • Familiarity with infrastructure components including networking, storage optimization, and resource management
  • Experience optimizing performance of diverse workloads in cloud environments
  • Strong programming skills, particularly in Python, and familiarity with the PyTorch ecosystem
  • Understanding of cloud infrastructure concepts and deployment patterns
  • Excellent written communication skills and ability to clearly express technical ideas in text

Practical experience

  • 2+ years of experience in software development, cloud engineering, DevOps, or a similar technical role
  • Demonstrated experience with cloud technologies and infrastructure
  • Previous work with infrastructure-as-code, containerization, and cloud environments

It will be an added bonus if you have

  • Experience with MLflow, Apache Airflow, or Kubeflow
  • Familiarity with cloud ML platforms like AWS, GCP, Azure ML, or NVIDIA NGC
  • Experience managing hybrid cloud or on-prem GPU infrastructure
  • Background working with technology partners and integrating third-party solutions
  • Public presentation skills

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

Equal Opportunity Statement:

Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire.

If you need accommodations during the application process, please let us know.

title: Area VP Sales, EMEA West
description_html:
At Semperis, our mission is to be a Force for Good. Starting with being a great place to work. We believe that when people feel valued, supported, and empowered, they do their best work. That’s why we focus on creating an employee experience rooted in purpose, growth, and balance. Semperis has been recognized as one of America’s Fastest-Growing Cybersecurity Companies by the Inc. 5000, a DUNS 100 Top Startup to Work For, and a multi-year Inc. Best Workplace awardee.

Semperis is looking for an Area Vice President of Sales to lead our EMEA West business and help shape the next phase of growth across France, Spain, Portugal, Italy, and Benelux.

Reporting to the VP of Sales, EMEA, you will lead and develop a team of Enterprise Sales Directors responsible for growing Semperis across their respective territories. This is a hands-on regional leadership role with direct influence on net-new ARR, team performance, customer outcomes, and market presence.

Semperis operates in one of the most important areas of enterprise cybersecurity: protecting the identity systems organisations depend on to operate and recover. We are looking for a leader who can help enterprise customers understand the business value of identity security and resilience, while building the team and operating discipline needed to capture the opportunity across EMEA West.

What you will do

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Enterprise Sales Directors to deliver net-new ARR against regional goals

  • Recruit, attract, and retain high-calibre enterprise sales talent as the organisation scales

  • Establish a clear operating rhythm across pipeline generation, deal inspection, forecasting, QBRs, performance reviews, and regional planning

  • Own the annual regional sales plan and build a disciplined pipeline engine that balances activity, opportunity quality, conversion, and coverage

  • Embed a consistent, methodology-led sales process using MEDDPICC or equivalent approaches; coach the team on qualification, territory planning, account strategy, value selling, and deal execution

  • Lead from the front in complex enterprise opportunities, improving deal strategy, supporting negotiation, and helping teams close in a timely way

  • Create clear standards of accountability and ownership through regular inspection, feedback, and follow-through

  • Build strong, strategic relationships with channel and alliance partners, and collaborate across Marketing, BDR, Product, Pre-Sales, Customer Success, Legal, andthe wider Semperis ecosystem to accelerate regional growth

  • Strengthen Semperis’ presence through customer advocacy, industry engagement, thought leadership, and relevant public relations activity

What great looks like

  • A high-performing, engaged team with clear expectations, strong development, and visible accountability

  • A predictable, data-led operating rhythm that drives qualified pipeline growth, accurate forecasts, and consistent net-new ARR across EMEA West

  • Enterprise Sales Directors who are improving their skills, raising their ambition, and taking greater ownership of higher-quality enterprise deals

  • Stronger negotiation and close execution through hands-on leadership in complex opportunities

  • Strategic use of channel and alliance partners and cross-functional resources to expand market reach and create opportunity

  • A respected Semperis presence with customers, partners, and the wider cybersecurity community

What you will bring

  • 10+ years’ experience selling cybersecurity, identity security, or adjacent technology solutions to large enterprise organisations through complex, multi-stakeholder buying processes

  • Proven leadership experience building, recruiting, and developing high-performing enterprise sales teams

  • Track record of delivering net-new ARR and achieving or exceeding regional growth targets

  • Strong sales operating discipline, including methodology-led qualification, pipeline inspection, forecast accuracy, and performance accountability; experience with MEDDPICC or equivalent approaches is strongly preferred

  • Frontline enterprise sales credibility, with strong commercial judgement across value, negotiation, and close strategy

  • Strong understanding of the information security channel and alliance ecosystem, with established regional relationships across enterprise customers, partners, and the cybersecurity community

  • Sufficient technical depth and commercial credibility to coach teams in complex security and identity conversations

  • People-focused leadership style that combines high standards with a low-ego, developmental approach

  • Proven success operating in a start-up or scale-up environment, with the pace, resilience, and ownership that it requires

  • Professional, confident communication style with customers, partners, executives, and internal stakeholders

  • Located in or around Paris, with willingness to travel approximately 50%

  • Fluency in both French and English is essential

Nice to have

  • Active Directory, Entra ID, identity security, hybrid identity, or adjacent cyber category exposure

  • Experience selling enterprise cybersecurity platforms rather than point products alone

  • Success scaling a relatively greenfield region or building structure in an underpenetrated market

  • Background with a pre-IPO, venture-backed, or high-growth cybersecurity vendor

  • Experience selling for an emerging or challenger brand, where market awareness and demand had to be built rather than inherited

  • Additional fluency in Italian, Spanish, or Portuguese

#LI-LP1

Why Join Semperis?
You’ll be part of a global team on the front lines of cybersecurity innovation. At Semperis, we celebrate curiosity, integrity, and people who take initiative. If you’re someone who sees the glass as half full, embraces challenges as growth opportunities, and values a healthy balance between work and life—we’d love to meet you.

**Semperis maintains office locations in several cities across the globe. Where the job description specifies a required location, candidates will follow our hybrid work model. This includes working up to three days per week and remotely the remaining days.

Semperis is an equal opportunity employer and will not discriminate against an applicant or employee based on race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), age, physical or mental disability, veteran or military status, genetic information, citizenship, marital status, or any other legally recognized protected basis under federal, state, or local law. The information collected by the Semperis application is solely to determine suitability for employment, verify identity, and maintain employment statistics.

Applicants with disabilities may be entitled to reasonable accommodation under the Americans with Disabilities Act and/or other applicable state or local laws. A reasonable accommodation is a change in the way things are normally done which will ensure an equal employment opportunity without imposing undue hardship on Semperis. Please inform Semperis representative Anna Taylor, Director of Global Recruiting, if you need assistance completing this application or to otherwise participate in the application process.

title: Enterprise Account Executive
description_html:
About Zip

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.

Your Role

  • You’re a closer, trusted advisor, product consultant – you’re working with prospects day-in-day-out to deliver immense ROI in an efficient, value-based sales cycle

  • You’re a hunter – you’ll get a healthy supply of BDR leads and marketing opportunities, but you’ll prospect and tap into your network to knock down doors and blockers

  • You’re a product evangelist – you’ll solution Zip to meet the pain points today, but also with an eye toward our product of the future

  • You’re a builder – at a startup, you’re not just a team member, but you help build the team culture and bring your best practice to the org

You Will

  • Become a product expert – learning the Zip platform through and through, so that you’re demo ready

  • Become a procurement expert – learning the ins and outs of the procurement market, which is deeply ready for change and new solutions

  • Use cutting-edge sales intelligence and engagement solutions to prospect, manage deal cycles, and ultimately bring on new customers

  • Be adaptable and flexible – as part of an early-stage hyper growth company, we are rapidly growing out our process but we want to you to help shape our sales process

Qualifications

  • 5+ year of closing experience in technology SaaS sales at enterprise level

  • Self driven – you don’t need someone to motivate you to put in your best every day

  • You’d describe yourself as organized, efficient with your time, and excellent communicator

  • Experience using tools like Salesforce, Zoominfo, LinkedIn SalesNav, and Outreach

  • Willing to go the extra mile to make sure our customers, company, team, and yourself succeed

  • Bachelor’s degree is required (specifically in Finance, Technology, or a related field or experiential equivalent)

Nice to Haves

  • Experience selling to procurement, finance, IT, legal

Perks & Benefits

At Zip, we’re committed to providing our employees with everything they need to do their best work.

  • Start-up equity

  • Health, vision & dental coverage

  • Team building events & happy hours

  • Flexible PTO

  • Apple equipment plus home office budget

We're looking to hire Zipsters and that means hiring people who take ownership, communicate openly, have an underdog mindset, and are excited to increase the pace of innovation for every business in the world. We encourage all candidates to apply even if your experience doesn't exactly match up to our job description. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workspace where everyone (regardless of age, religion, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, and more) feels like they belong. We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Sales Compensation Analyst
description_html:
At Semperis, our mission is to be a Force for Good. Starting with being a great place to work. We believe that when people feel valued, supported, and empowered, they do their best work. That’s why we focus on creating an employee experience rooted in purpose, growth, and balance. Semperis has been recognized as one of America’s Fastest-Growing Cybersecurity Companies by the Inc. 5000, a DUNS 100 Top Startup to Work For, and a multi-year Inc. Best Workplace awardee.

Why this role matters

Sales, channel, renewals, BDR, and corporate bonus participants across Semperis count on being paid correctly and on time. As our Senior Sales Compensation Analyst, you'll own the system and the monthly cycle that make that happen. You'll run calculations in Xactly Incent, tie every result back to its source data, and give Finance a close it can trust. The hardest part of the job is judgment: knowing when a variance is a data fix you can make yourself, and when it's a plan question that needs a leader's approval before anything moves.

What you'll own

· Run the recurring commission and incentive calculation cycle, from source data validation to an approved payment file delivered to Payroll within the monthly close window.

· Investigate and resolve discrepancies in assignments, splits, credits, quotas, rates, currencies, and adjustments, and document every true up and correction before payment is released.

· Reconcile Xactly Incent against Salesforce, HR, payroll, and Finance systems each month and quarter, and support close, including commission accruals, in partnership with our Revenue Analyst.

· Build and maintain audit ready documentation and controls so the commission process is repeatable and any reviewer can follow it.

· Administer Xactly Incent across all company plans, keeping participant data, access, hierarchies, quotas, rates, and plan assignments current as people join, move, and leave.

· Lead the annual implementation of every compensation plan in Xactly, working with Revenue Operations and the Global Compensation Director through configuration, testing, and approvals.

· Own plan letter administration end to end, from preparation and issuance through signature tracking.

· Turn large datasets into clear reporting on attainment, commissions, and payments, and help managers and employees understand their plans and statements, including findings they may not want to hear.

What success looks like

· Every cycle closes on time, with an approved payment file and every discrepancy investigated and documented before sign off.

· Each period ties out across systems, with variances explained and evidence ready for auditors.

· Every approved plan is configured, tested, and live before the plan year opens, and every participant holds a current signed plan letter.

· Participants understand their statements, and disputes are resolved with facts rather than escalation.

Who you'll work with

You'll report to our Director of Finance and work closely with the CFO, Revenue Operations leaders and plan owners, and department heads across sales and channel. You'll also partner with HR, Legal, Payroll, Accounting, FP&A, our Xactly technical account manager, and external auditors.

What you'll bring

· 3-5 years of relevant experience in incentive compensation or commission operations

· Hands on experience administering Xactly Incent, including plan configuration, participant data, hierarchies, quotas, and rates

· Strong reconciliation skills, with a track record of tracing variances to root cause across multiple systems

· Advanced Excel, including formulas, pivot tables, and lookups

· Experience maintaining documented procedures and audit evidence

· Clear, steady communication when explaining plan mechanics or delivering unwelcome findings

· Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

Nice to have

· Experience with Workday and NetSuite

· Experience supporting global incentive programs across multiple countries or currencies

· Experience in a public company, high tech or SaaS environment,

· Familiarity with US GAAP including ASC 606, and background in variable pay payroll, Sales or Revenue Operations, accounting, audit or financial analysis.

Why Join Semperis?
You’ll be part of a global team on the front lines of cybersecurity innovation. At Semperis, we celebrate curiosity, integrity, and people who take initiative. If you’re someone who sees the glass as half full, embraces challenges as growth opportunities, and values a healthy balance between work and life—we’d love to meet you.

title: Product Engineering - Future Opportunities
description_html:
Who is Tenable?

Tenable® is the Exposure Management company. Over 40,000 organizations around the globe rely on Tenable to understand and reduce cyber risk. Our global employees support 65 percent of the Fortune 500, 50 percent of the Global 2000, and large government agencies. Come be part of our journey!

What makes Tenable such a great place to work?

Ask a member of our team and they’ll answer, “Our people!” We work together to build and innovate best-in-class cybersecurity solutions for our customers; all while creating a culture of belonging, respect, and excellence where we can be our best selves. When you’re part of our #OneTenable team, you can expect to partner with some of the most talented and passionate people in the industry, and have the support and resources you need to do work that truly matters. We deliver results that exceed expectations and we win together!

If you are interested in a position in Engineering but don't see what you are looking for, please send us your resume. We will keep it on file and reach out when we find a match.

Tenable's Engineering Department is the company's heartbeat. Our scrum teams work in locations around the globe, building architectures and developing code for our innovative products, fulfilling SRE and DevOps roles, providing testing and QA services -- insuring that Tenable brings it's best to the market every day!

Positions in Engineering generally require a background in Computer Science, Software Engineering (or similar) and some experience working in an agile, team focused organization.

In the United States, we typically hire in one of our hub locations - Columbia, MD; Boston, MA; and the San Francisco, CA Bay Area. Globally, Engineers are hired in Dublin, Ireland; Tel Aviv, Israel; and Paris, France. Some positions require a hybrid work schedule (2 days a week in the office) and others are fully remote. Required location(s) are posted for each individual opening.

#LI-DNI

We’re committed to promoting Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) at Tenable - through all equal employment opportunity laws and regulations at the international, federal, state and local levels. If you need a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please contact Recruiting@Tenable.com for further assistance.

Tenable is committed to protecting the privacy and security of your personal data. Depending on your location, one or more of the following notices may apply to you:

General Applicant Privacy Notice
California Applicant Privacy Notice
EU/EEA/UK Applicant Privacy Notice
