title: Growth Marketing Corporate - France
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Doctrine
description_html:
Notre mission ⚖️

Chez Doctrine, nous construisons le leader de l’IA juridique en Europe.

Notre conviction ? Le droit ne doit pas être ralenti par des tâches répétitives. Il doit être augmenté par une IA spécialisée, conçue pour comprendre, analyser et produire du raisonnement juridique avec un haut niveau d’exigence.

Notre ambition ? Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée.

Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance.

Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales.

Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction.

Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début.


Chez Doctrine, on grandit vite. Très vite. De l'organique (nouveaux produits, nouveaux pays) comme de l'externe : 5 boîtes rachetées en 3 ans.
Résultat en 2026 : près de 30 000 clients dans 5 pays : France, Allemagne, Italie, Luxembourg et Espagne. Et sur notre marché historique, la France, on est loin d'avoir fini de jouer.

Doctrine est le leader européen de l'IA juridique. Mais un juriste d'entreprise ne travaille pas comme un avocat, et un dirigeant n'a pas les mêmes attentes qu'un juriste du secteur public.

Le segment Corporate (juristes privés et publics, experts et dirigeants d'entreprises) a ses propres codes, ses propres enjeux. C'est là que tu entres en scène : faire décoller la croissance de Doctrine sur le Corporate France.

Ton objectif n°1 : faire grimper l'ARR de Doctrine sur le segment Corporate en France. Un rôle stratégique, au cœur de la machine Go-to-Market, qui touche tout le funnel : acquisition, activation, rétention (upsell, cross-sell inclus).

L'équipe que tu rejoins

Tu rejoins une équipe Growth de 4 personnes : ton futur manager, deux Growths sur les marchés internationaux et une personne sur le segment Avocat sur le marché français. En face, une vraie force de frappe commerciale que tu vas alimenter au quotidien : 10 BDR, 13 Account Executives et 6 Account Managers. Les leads que tu génères ont donc un terrain de jeu à la hauteur et ton impact se voit vite.

Le point de départ (plutôt sympa 👀)

  • Un modèle SaaS en forte croissance… et rentable (oui, les deux)
  • Un product market fit avec du momentum : près de 30 000 avocats et juristes déjà clients
  • Une équipe Go-to-Market (Marketing, RevenueOps & Sales) au top pour t'aider à dénicher de nouvelles poches de croissance
  • Une place de leader européen sur une des catégories les plus dynamique au monde : l'IA juridique
  • Une stack à la pointe et une bibliothèque de contenus déjà bien fournie pour dégainer sur les bons leviers et les objections de vente

Tes missions :

Au sein de l'équipe Growth, en collaboration avec les Sales Corporate et l’équipe marketing (PMM, Com, Event) tu passes tes journées à affûter le funnel sur le segment Corporate. Et surtout : tout est challengeable.

  • GTM Synch : animer les points réguliers avec l'équipe Sales Corporate pour définir avec eux, les priorités de campagnes en fonction des besoins terrain. Tu es le trait d'union entre le Growth et les Sales.
  • Outbound Lead Gen : dénicher les bons contacts pour les Sales et lancer les campagnes d'activation (enrichissement, automation, séquences, suivi des perfs).
  • Inbound Lead Gen : Aide au pilotage avec notre agence des campagnes sur Meta, LinkedIn et Google, pour générer un max de leads qualifiés.
  • Nurturing & customer education :
  • Bâtir et faire tourner les campagnes de nurturing sur des leads et contacts,
  • Épauler le Product Marketing sur les lancements produits et les campagnes d’usages à destination de nos utilisateurs,
  • Être le bras droit du marketing sur nos events, webinars et product launches.

    • Le profil qu'on recherche :

    Tu es la personne idéale si tu as envie d’avoir de l’impact, aimes avancer vite et tester de nouvelles approches aussi bien que maintenir des systèmes de campagnes en placer. Et évidemment, tu as à coeur de sortir un copywriting qui poussera à l’action.

    Pour le reste ? Pas besoin d'être un marketeur pur jus. Ops, RevOps, Tech, tous les chemins mènent au Growth. Ce qui compte vraiment : l'envie d'apprendre et de mettre les mains dans le cambouis pour faire grandir Doctrine.

    Hard skills

  • L'IA, c'est ton copilote : ce poste se travaille à 100 % avec l'IA. Production de campagnes, copywriting, analyse, automatisation. Un réflexe quotidien.

description_html:
Our Mission ⚖️

At Doctrine, we're building Europe's leading legal AI platform.

Our belief? Law shouldn't be slowed down by repetitive tasks. It should be augmented by a specialised AI, designed to understand, analyse and produce legal reasoning at the highest standard.

Our ambition? To help legal professionals work with greater reliability, efficiency and peace of mind, through a single, comprehensive and secure platform.

Today, 27,000 legal professionals across five countries (France, Italy, Germany, Spain and Luxembourg) trust us to do just that.

Our growth is guided by a clear approach: a global vision, grounded in a deep understanding of local specificities.

Behind this ambition, a team of around 250 people, united around one goal: supporting lawyers and legal professionals at every stage of their work, from research to drafting.

And we're just getting started.


We grow fast. Really fast. Organically (new products, new countries) and through acquisitions: 5 companies snapped up in 3 years, including a fresh one in Spain. The result in 2026: close to 30,000 customers across 5 countries. The German market? It just blew out its first birthday candle.

Doctrine is the European leader in legal AI. But a German lawyer doesn't work like a French one, and in-house counsel in Berlin don't have quite the same needs as their Paris counterparts. Every market has its own playbook. That's where you come in: putting Doctrine's growth in Germany into overdrive.

 

The team you're joining

A Growth team of 4: your future manager, one Growth on Italy, two on France. We're hunting for the 5th avenger to complete the squad and take full ownership of the German market. On the other side of the table, a team of full-funnel Account Executives ready to turn the leads you generate into wins.

The starting point (pretty sweet, honestly 👀)

  • A high-growth SaaS model, and a profitable one (yes, both)
  • Rock-solid product-market fit with real momentum: close to 30,000 lawyers and legal professionals already on board
  • A top-tier Go-to-Market team (Marketing, RevenueOps & Sales) to help you uncover new pockets of growth
  • An established spot as the European leader of a category we helped invent: legal AI
  • A cutting-edge tooling stack and a loaded content library to fire on the right levers and shut down objections

Your missions

Inside the Growth team, hand in hand with Sales, PMM and Product, you spend your days sharpening the German funnel, a mix of inbound and outbound. And the best part: everything is open to challenge. Got a better idea? We're all ears.

  • Internationalization: design and roll out local campaigns built for the codes and expectations of the German market (no copy-paste from France).
  • Inbound Lead Gen: team up with our agency to build campaigns that hit hard on Meta, LinkedIn and Google, and pull in as many qualified leads as possible.
  • Outbound Lead Gen: pinpoint the right contacts for the sales teams and fire up activation campaigns (enrichment, automation, sequences, performance tracking).
  • Nurturing: build and run nurturing campaigns on our leads, plus product-usage campaigns with existing customers, to max out conversion and retention.
  • Field Marketing & Product Growth: back the PMM team on product launches and be field marketing's right hand on our events, webinars and product launches.

The profile we're looking for

You're our 5th avenger if you're not afraid to build campaigns day in, day out and copywriting is your thing (better yet, you love it). And, of course: you need to speak German.

For the rest? No need to be a pure-bred marketer. Ops, RevOps, Tech, all roads lead to Growth. What really counts: the drive to learn and to get your hands dirty to help Doctrine grow.

Hard skills

  • AI is your copilot: this role runs 100% with AI, campaign production, copywriting, analysis, automation. A daily reflex, not a gimmick.
  • Hands-on experience with marketing automation, sales engagement and CRM tools (Salesforce, HubSpot, Outreach, Intercom, Lemlist…).
  • A solid grasp of how data flows between tools, to build, challenge and optimize customer and prospect journeys.
  • A real appetite for copywriting and for understanding what makes our audience tick.
  • A drive to build strategies that last, not just quick & dirty wins.
  • Analytical skills (SQL is a nice bonus).

Soft skills

  • Fluent or native German, non-negotiable: you write and think your campaigns in the language of the market. Professional English also required.
  • Strong communicator who lets the data do the talking when it's time to decide.
  • Creative and curious about user psychology, to design programs that leave a mark.
  • A real team player: you move through cross-functional teams and get everyone's stakes to land the best action plans.

Our stack 🛠️

Salesforce · HubSpot · Outreach · Intercom · Lemlist · Mixpanel · Google Analytics · Metabase · Zapier/Make

What's in it for you ☀️

🏡 A flexible remote work policy, allowing up to three days of remote work per week (depending on your team).

🌴 A flexible leave policy

🌱 Real internal mobility opportunities

🏄‍♂️ Regular team events

📚 A genuine focus on individual and collective learning, with a €750 annual budget for any training related to your role, plus team-wide and company-wide training sessions

🏋️‍♀️ A Gymlib subscription for sports and wellness activities

🧘 Free access to the Moka.care mental health support platform, including up to 6 individual sessions per year

👩‍⚕️ Health insurance with Alan

🍱🚲 A Swile card for meal vouchers and sustainable mobility allowance (€66.60/month)

💡 Discounts and perks via our Works Council (CSE) on the Happypal platform

🍏 Brand new Apple equipment

Our values 🤝

At Doctrine, our 4 values guide us every day as we work to move things forward.

Challenge the status quo: we champion bold ideas that drive change across an entire industry.

Liberty and responsibility: we encourage autonomy, individual impact and ownership.

Knowledge is power: information is at the heart of Doctrine's mission, and we constantly strive to grow.

Release early, release often and listen to your customers: we believe in the power of iteration and in constantly listening to our market, our customers and their challenges.

 Our hiring process 🚀

  1. A 30-min intro call with one of our Talent Acquisition Managers to understand your career goals and walk you through what we're building at Doctrine.
  2. A 1-hour conversation with your future manager to dive into the role, team scope and answer all your questions.
  3. One or two technical assessments to evaluate your skills in practice.
  4. An office visit including: lunch with 3 people from different teams to give you a feel for your future colleagues; a values conversation to share our vision; and a meeting with our CEO, Guillaume.

(The process can be adapted to fit your personal and professional constraints if needed.)

Ladies, go ahead and apply!

Research shows that women in particular tend not to apply for a role when they don't meet every single requirement. To put your mind at ease: this job description is a guide, nothing more.

If Doctrine interests you, we'd love to hear from you!

Diversity & inclusion

All our roles are open to people with disabilities. Feel free to bring it up at any point during the process. We're committed to putting in place whatever adjustments are needed to ensure a working environment that works for everyone.

  • Aller chercher de l'ARR supplémentaire et de la croissance via de l'upsell ou du cross-sell
  • Prévenir et minimiser l’attrition
  • Gérer, développer et nourrir un portefeuille de clients en développant des relations solides avec les utilisateurs et les décideurs
  • Contribuer au développement direct de notre produit en remontant les retours des clients aux équipes techniques et produits

description_html:
Job Title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager
Type: Full-time
Location: Paris 
 
What about us?
 
Launched in 2023, INFINIT is a fast-growing fintech scale-up operating in multiple countries across Europe and Americas.
 
At INFINIT we are on a mission to reshape the future of SMEs with AI at the forefront. Our all-in-one operating system has banking at its core, and empowers small business owners and their teams to seamlessly manage and optimize every aspect of their business with AI agents.
 
By focussing on specific industries, INFINIT delivers tailored, high-value solutions, while building innovative AI products to further unlock significant growth opportunities for our customers. INFINIT operates globally, with ambitions to further expand its footprint to redefine the fintech landscape for SMEs worldwide.
 
Join us on the INFINIT journey as we revolutionise the SME economy and drive meaningful impact through innovation 🚀 
 
The Role

We have signed our largest customer to date: a European automotive dealer group operating hundreds of agencies across several countries, with thousands of daily users moving their entire used-vehicle operation onto INFINIT.

As the Enterprise Customer Success Manager — Dealer Groups, based in Paris, you own that relationship. Not as one of ten logos in a portfolio — this is one account, and you go deep into it. You will know their network, their brands, their agency managers and their numbers better than anyone at INFINIT, and you will be the name they think of when they think of us.

The role has two chapters. The first is the migration: you are embedded with the pilot agencies while we tailor the product, and you then own the deployment programme for the whole network — the setup of every agency and the rollout, country by country, on a committed date. Our project leads own the integration and the custom development; getting hundreds of agencies configured, trained and live is yours. The second chapter is the one that lasts: once we are live, this is pure enterprise account management at depth — adoption across thousands of users, the group's commercial results, the renewal, and the expansion of INFINIT across everything else they do.

If your idea of account management is quarterly reviews and a shared inbox, this will not suit you. You will spend real time in dealerships.


What do we want to achieve together?

First chapter — land it (through the migration)

  • Be embedded with the pilot agencies. On site, in the showroom, next to used-vehicle managers, sales advisors and call-centre agents. You learn how they genuinely work — not how it was described in a meeting room — and you make the pilot succeed on their terms.

  • Own the deployment programme. You build and run the rollout plan for hundreds of agencies: sequencing, setup and configuration, user provisioning, training, go-live criteria, hypercare, and the migration tracker the group's leadership reads every week. This is genuine programme ownership — you hold the plan, not someone else's.

  • Lead through the group's regional supervisors. Your closest allies on the ground are the group's regional supervisors — their people, not ours, covering each part of the network. You set the plan, the cadence and the standards with them, and you make the programme theirs to succeed at, in an organisation where nobody reports to you. On our side, you can draw on INFINIT's Operations Agents for setup, configuration and data work.

  • Run the product feedback loop. You are the single channel between the group and our Product & Engineering teams. You separate a genuine platform gap from a habit dressed up as a requirement, write requirements engineers can act on, and hold a prioritised backlog the customer recognises as theirs.

  • Protect the date without breaking trust. Hundreds of agencies migrate inside a single quarter with a hard cut-over. You are the one who sees the risk early, says so, and gets it fixed.

    • Second chapter — grow it (the long game)

  • Drive adoption and value, agency by agency. You track usage across the network, spot the sites that are behind, understand why, and fix it. You know which agencies love us and which ones are quietly not using us — and you never learn that from a dashboard alone.

  • Be the group's business partner, not their vendor contact. You understand their stock turn, their margin per vehicle, their lead conversion. You bring them insight they don't have, and you are credible with agency managers, with the DSI and with general management alike.

  • Own the commercial outcome. Retention and renewal of our largest contract, plus the expansion of INFINIT across the group — above all the deployment of our AI agents into their day-to-day operations.

  • Turn one account into a model. What you learn becomes INFINIT's enterprise dealer-group playbook.


    • What do you need to be successful in this role?

  • 5+ years in enterprise account management in B2B SaaS, owning a small number of large, complex, multi-site customers — not a broad portfolio. You have carried retention and growth on an account that mattered to your company.

  • You have run a multi-site deployment, not inherited one post-go-live. A rollout you personally planned and delivered: the sequencing, the readiness criteria, the training plan, the tracker, the escalation path. We will want the detail — how many sites, what broke, how you held the date.

  • You can lead people who don't report to you. The group's regional supervisors and site managers on one side; INFINIT's Operations Agents, Product and Support teams on the other. You set direction through clarity and credibility rather than authority.

  • Genuinely hands-on. You are comfortable being the most operational person in the room, doing training sessions yourself, sitting with end users for a full day, and being reachable when a site has a problem.

  • Credible in two very different rooms. A technical and contractual conversation with a group IT director, and a full day in a dealership with a used-vehicle manager who has no interest in software. Neither is a performance for you.

  • Product instinct. You are genuinely interested in how the product works, you can arbitrate configuration versus build, and you are comfortable telling a customer no and explaining why.

  • Native-level French and fluent English. A further European language is a strong advantage.

  • Willingness to be in the field. Expect roughly one to two days a week travelling across France during the migration phases, plus regular travel to the group's other European markets, and continued field presence afterwards.

  • Automotive retail experience is a real plus — used vehicles, DMS, stock, pricing, listings, leads — but curiosity for it is the non-negotiable part. You will spend a lot of time on the subject of used cars.


    • What will you find working at INFINIT?
  • Competitive Salary and Equity: We offer highly competitive salaries and a stake in our success with share options because we're building this together.
  • Diverse and Inclusive Team: Join a dynamic and international team in excess of 8 nationalities. You'll have the chance to work with experienced professionals from around the world, fostering a rich learning environment.
  • Inspiring Mission: We are dedicated to revolutionizing business financing and making a    positive impact on the European economy. Your work at INFINIT will have a lasting effect on businesses and communities.
  • Health and Well-being: Your health matters to us. You will have access to top-quality Medical & Mental Health Insurance.
  • Corporate Gym Discount
  • Quality Time Together: We foster a sense of community with annual gatherings and bi-weekly office team gatherings. You're more than welcome to join us for quality time.
  • Personal Time Off: Enjoy flexibility with your personal time off.
  • Flexibility and Ownership: We trust our team and we are goal-oriented. Enjoy the flexibility of hybrid working 3 days a week in our Paris office and 2 from home
    • Diversity and Inclusion
     
    INFINIT promotes an inclusive culture that seeks equity and values different perspectives. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally protected characteristic.

title: Senior Asset Pipeline Engineer, Sim-Ready Content
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Genesis
description_html:
About Genesis AI

Genesis AI builds the simulation platform powering the next generation of robotics and embodied AI. Our flagship product, Genesis World, is a unified multi-physics simulation engine paired with Nyx, our in-house GPU-accelerated, path-traced photorealistic renderer. Together they provide a platform for training robotics and embodied AI at scale; letting teams simulate complex physical worlds with high fidelity and speed, from a laptop to datacenter-grade GPUs, and close the gap between simulation and the real world.

About the Role

A simulator is only as useful as the content that runs inside it. Training embodied agents at scale means large volumes of assets that are simultaneously physically valid and visually convincing and that is a pipeline problem before it is an art problem.

We're hiring a Senior Engineer to build the path from raw input to sim-ready asset: geometry from a range of sources going in; clean meshes, correct collision proxies, plausible physical properties, materials that hold up under a path tracer, and reliable metadata coming out.

The bar is throughput and repeatability. An asset that needs a human pass to be usable doesn't scale, so the pipeline has to make good decisions on its own and flag the cases where it can't.

Part of that autonomy comes from agents embedded in the graph itself. Nodes can call models to produce input content, drive generation, pick parameters, interpret a mesh before deciding how to treat it, or judge whether a result is acceptable. Making that reliable is its own engineering problem: agents are non-deterministic, they fail in ways a mesh operator doesn't, and they need guardrails, structured outputs, retries and verification around them. You'll be building that as a first-class part of the pipeline rather than bolting it on.

You'll work closely with the stakeholders, who set direction and priorities. You own the technical design and the implementation and you're expected to bring enough pipeline experience to challenge the plan where it needs challenging.

What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain the end-to-end asset pipeline, from ingestion through to validated output

  • Design agent-driven nodes that generate input content and make decisions inside the graph, with the structured outputs, guardrails and fallbacks that make them dependable in batch

  • Develop automated processing stages: mesh repair, retopology, decimation and LODs, UV unwrapping and texel density normalization, collision proxy generation

  • Derive physical properties so assets behave correctly in simulation: mass, inertia, contact parameters, articulation setup

  • Handle appearance: material conversion to PBR, texture processing, baking, and color management so assets render correctly in Nyx

  • Define and enforce asset standards (units, orientation, pivots, naming, provenance) and build the validators that reject noncompliant assets before they reach the library

  • Scale the pipeline to large batch runs, with caching, versioning and selective reprocessing when a stage changes

  • Build quality checks into the pipeline itself: physics stability harnesses, render smoke tests, automated evaluation of generated content, comparison on reprocessed assets

  • Work with the rendering, physics and research teams on what sim-ready needs to mean for each downstream use

What We're Looking For (ideally)

  • 5+ years building content or asset pipelines in games, VFX, simulation, or 3D tooling, with ownership of a pipeline in production

  • Deep knowledge of 3D asset formats and their quirks: USD, glTF, FBX, OBJ, plus physics description formats such as URDF or MJCF

  • Strong Python and C++ where processing needs to be fast

  • Hands-on mesh processing expertise: remeshing, decimation, UV generation, repair operations, convex decomposition, and a clear sense of how each one fails

  • Solid command of PBR material authoring, texture baking and color spaces

  • Experience driving DCC tools headlessly (Blender, Houdini, Maya) and building batch or distributed job systems around them

  • Practical experience putting LLM or agent calls into production systems: prompting, tool use, structured output, cost and latency control, and handling non-determinism

  • Understanding of what makes an asset physically valid in a simulator: visual versus collision geometry, mass properties, contact behavior, numerical stability

  • Judgment about quality bars, including when an asset is good enough and when it isn't

Nice to Have

  • Experience processing output from generative or reconstruction-based 3D sources, and evaluating that output automatically

  • Agent frameworks, orchestration and eval tooling applied to content generation

  • OpenUSD at scale: composition, layering, MaterialX

  • Semantic annotation and dataset curation at volume

  • Exposure to simulation stacks such as MuJoCo, Isaac Sim or similar

title: Integrity Operations Specialist
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Bumble Inc.
description_html:
Introduction to Role & Team

Bumble Inc. is looking for an Integrity Operations Specialist to join our Trust Operations team. Trust and safety are central to Bumble’s mission to create a world where all relationships are healthy and equitable, and in this role you’ll help bring that mission to life by supporting members through some of their most sensitive and challenging experiences.

You’ll investigate safety concerns, review accounts and content against Bumble Inc.’s Community Guidelines, and provide compassionate, trauma-informed support to members who have experienced safety incidents. You’ll work across a range of complex and sensitive issues, using established policies, operational guidance, sound judgment, and AI-supported tools to reach fair and consistent outcomes. You’ll also collaborate closely with colleagues across Trust & Safety, Customer Experience, and Legal, taking ownership of cases and demonstrating our Bumble values of Respect, Curiosity, and Excellence in how you support our community and one another.

This role will be based in the U.S. and will report to the Senior Integrity Operations Manager.

Please note that this position involves exposure to sensitive and graphic content, including but not limited to vulgar, violent, and sexual content.

What you’ll do

  • Investigate and take action on member reports and proactive detections involving safety concerns, including harassment, threats, non-consensual imagery, and other potential violations of Bumble Inc.’s Community Guidelines.

  • Provide thoughtful, high-touch and trauma-informed support to members who have experienced safety incidents, demonstrating Respect and care while following established safety processes.

  • Review accounts and content flagged for potential safety violations, applying policies and operational guidance consistently while using sound judgment to determine appropriate next steps.

  • Manage sensitive and time-critical cases with attention to detail, taking ownership of your work and seeing cases through from initial review to an appropriate outcome.

  • Collaborate purposefully with Trust & Safety, Customer Experience, Legal, and other partners to escalate and help resolve cases that require additional expertise or support.

  • Identify recurring issues, patterns, and opportunities to improve workflows, sharing insights that can strengthen operational consistency and member safety.

  • Use AI-supported tools and internal systems to improve efficiency and support decision-making, reviewing outputs critically for accuracy, bias, privacy, and fairness and applying human judgment before taking action.

  • Participate in on-call rotations, including evenings, weekends, and holidays as needed, adapting with an agile mindset to support our global community.

About you

  • Requires 1+ years of experience, though we welcome candidates with alternative backgrounds that demonstrate equivalent skills.

  • Bring experience in Trust & Safety, customer support, crisis response, content moderation, or another environment where you have handled sensitive or safety-related issues.

  • Are comfortable reviewing potentially distressing content, including material relating to child exploitation, sexual or physical violence, suicide and self-harm, while approaching this work with care and professionalism.

  • Communicate clearly and compassionately in writing and verbally, particularly when supporting vulnerable individuals or navigating sensitive situations.

  • Apply sound judgment within established policies and processes, balancing efficiency with careful, consistent decision-making and demonstrating Bumble’s values of Respect and Excellence.

  • Collaborate purposefully with colleagues, take ownership of your work, and maintain an agile mindset as priorities, cases, and operational needs evolve.

  • Proficiency in Spanish, Portuguese, French, or another language in addition to English is welcomed but not required.

About Us

Bumble Inc. is the parent company of Bumble Date, BFF, and Badoo. The Bumble platform enables people to build healthy and equitable relationships, through Kind Connections. Founded by Whitney Wolfe Herd in 2014, Bumble was one of the first dating apps built with women at the center and connects people across dating (Bumble Date) and friendship (BFF). BFF is a friendship app where people in all stages of life can meet people nearby and create meaningful platonic connections and community based on shared interests. Badoo, which was founded in 2006, is one of the pioneers of web and mobile dating products.

AI Fluency

AI is important to us. We’re excited by people who are curious and experimental, and who think thoughtfully about how AI can amplify their impact and outcomes.

We encourage you to use AI responsibly as you prepare your application. Please don’t use it to fabricate experiences or answer questions live in interviews. We care deeply about authenticity and want to understand your real skills, judgment and voice, because building a meaningful, genuine connection with you matters to us.

Final Compensation

Will be determined based on factors such as the selected candidate’s qualifications, relevant experience, skill set, and other job-related considerations.

Inclusion at Bumble Inc.

Bumble Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and we strongly encourage people of all ages, color, lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, queer and non-binary people, veterans, parents, people with disabilities, and neurodivergent people to apply. We're happy to make any reasonable adjustments that will help you feel more confident throughout the process, please don't hesitate to let us know how we can help.

In your application, please feel free to note which pronouns you use (For example: she/her, he/him, they/them, etc).

AI in Bumble Inc. Hiring

At Bumble, we may use AI tools to support parts of our recruitment process — such as helping us record, transcribe, and summarize conversations, and supporting job alignment by comparing resumes and job descriptions to highlight skills and potential roles that may be a good match. These tools help us work more efficiently and stay focused on you during our conversations. Importantly, all hiring decisions are made by people. AI is used only to support our team’s efficiency and improve the candidate experience — not to evaluate or decide on your candidacy. Participation in AI-supported interviews and conversations is completely voluntary and will not impact your candidacy. If you’d prefer to opt out, simply let your recruiter or interviewer know at the start of a call, or anytime during the interview or conversation. Summaries and related data are retained only as long as needed in line with our internal data retention policies. If at any point you’d like a transcription or summary deleted, please contact your recruiter directly.

Fraudulent Candidate Detection

Our applicant tracking system analyzes signals relating to device, IP, email, and phone data associated with each application to protect applicants and our hiring process from fraudulent applications. These signals provide indicators for internal review only and do not constitute a definitive determination of identity or intent. No applicant is rejected, advanced, or otherwise affected based solely on this analysis without human review

For further information on how we hold and manage your data, please refer to our Privacy Policy.

title: IT Manager

description_html:
About the role

We're looking for an IT Manager to own the day-to-day IT that keeps the company running smoothly and securely as we grow. This covers our people's devices, the office network, the tools everyone uses, and the support they rely on. It's a hands-on role for someone who enjoys solving practical problems and making everyday IT work well, reporting into the CIO and based in London.

A big part of the job is security in a practical, operational sense. You'll keep devices patched and well configured, control who has access to what, bring order to the software and accounts that build up as a company grows, and make joining and leaving smooth and secure. You'll operate the controls and standards that the security team sets, and you'll be the person who makes them real in day-to-day work.

You'll work across the whole company, so you'll need to balance keeping people productive with keeping them secure, and be comfortable being the go-to person for anything IT.

Job responsibilities

  • Own endpoint security in practice, including device configuration, patching, controlling local admin rights, and reducing unmanaged software

  • Look after workplace and network security, including the office network and keeping guest and corporate access properly separated

  • Run identity operations day to day, including provisioning, joiner, mover and leaver changes, and regular access reviews

  • Manage software and licensing across the company, and bring order to tools that have crept in without oversight

  • Manage 3rd party vendors such as internet suppliers

  • Look after the office network, devices and everyday hardware

  • Run the IT helpdesk and make sure people get quick, helpful support

  • Make joining and leaving the company a smooth, well-run experience

About you

Skills, experience and qualifications

  • Experience managing IT operations in a growing company

  • Hands-on with device management and endpoint tooling

  • Comfortable with identity and access operations, including provisioning and access reviews

  • Experience managing software, licensing and the sprawl that builds up over time

  • Experience managing corporate network infrastructure and equipment

  • Experience running a helpdesk or support function and keeping users happy

  • A security-minded, practical approach to everyday IT

Benefits

  • Private medical insurance

  • Income protection insurance

  • Life insurance of 4 * base salary

  • On-site gym and shower facilities

  • Enhanced maternity and paternity pay

  • Team social events and company parties

  • Salary exchange on pension and nursery fees

  • Access to Maji, the financial wellbeing platform

  • Company stock options managed through Ledgy

  • Milestone Birthday Bonus and a Life Events leave policy

description_html:
About the role

We're looking for someone to build our security operations capability from the ground up. This covers how we spot when something is wrong, how we respond when it is, and how we keep improving both. It's a hands-on leadership role for the early stages, so you'll be setting things up and running them, not managing a large team from day one.

You'll design how we do detection and monitoring for security, decide the right mix of in-house work and outsourced support, and set up how alerts are handled and escalated. You'll also lead how we respond to incidents, working closely with our engineering and reliability colleagues, since a lot of this sits alongside how they already keep our services running.

This is a deeply collaborative role. In particular you'll work hand in hand with our site reliability engineering (SRE) team, since much of security monitoring and response builds on the same tooling and ways of working they already use to keep our services running. We want to avoid heavy, siloed processes and instead build a lean, practical capability that fits how the rest of the business works, bringing in specialist help where it makes sense.

Job responsibilities

  • Set up detection and monitoring for security across the platform and wider IT, including the tooling, dashboards and log sources needed to investigate quickly

  • Decide how much we run ourselves and where we use outsourced monitoring or response, and own that relationship

  • Set up how security alerts are handled, owned and escalated, starting with working-hours coverage

  • Lead how we respond to security incidents, including playbooks for the most likely scenarios, a single place of record, and regular practice exercises

  • Work with the reliability team on resilience and recovery, including backups, restore testing and disaster-recovery exercises

  • Triage vulnerabilities found in our running systems and infrastructure into a shared tracker

  • Run exercises that test and improve our defences over time

About you

Skills, experience and qualifications

  • Experience building or leading security operations, or detection and response, ideally somewhere you had to set it up rather than inherit it

  • Strong grounding in detection and monitoring, including logging, alerting and building useful detections

  • Experience leading incident response, including playbooks, exercises and learning from what happened

  • A strongly collaborative approach, with real experience working alongside site reliability or platform engineering teams and sharing tooling where it makes sense

  • Experience choosing and managing outsourced monitoring or response providers

  • A practical, low-drama approach that keeps things proportionate

  • Willing to explore where AI can help in security monitoring and response, and pragmatic about applying it where it genuinely fits the use case

We especially want to hear from you if you have:

  • Built a security operations capability in a scale-up

  • Worked in InsurTech, FinTech or another regulated industry

  • Experience with detection and response in cloud-based environments

  • Run tabletop or disaster-recovery exercises

  • Experience with offensive and defensive testing to sharpen defences

description_html:
About Artificial

Help shape the future of specialty insurance

At Artificial, we’re building the next generation of technology for the specialty (re)insurance market. Our mission is to transform how brokers and carriers operate in complex markets by removing operational barriers and enabling smarter, faster decision-making.

We use modern technology to solve real challenges for some of the world’s leading brokers and insurers. By automating the repetitive and structuring the complex, we help our partners unlock new opportunities for innovation and growth.

You’ll be joining a collaborative team that values curiosity, ownership, and continuous learning. We work in an environment where ideas are heard, support is built-in, and outcomes matter. Everyone here has the chance to make a tangible impact on our products, our customers, and the industry.

We've just raised $45M (£33M) in Series B funding from lead investor CommerzVentures, new investor Move Capital, as well as all existing shareholders. This investment round gives us the room to grow with confidence, continue to innovate, and ensure that Artificial remains the first choice for brokers and carriers seeking a smarter way to trade digitally.

Join us, and take the chance to be a part of something that will change the landscape of insurance for generations.

Role Background

We are looking for a skilled and personable Lead Forward Deployed Engineer to lead a team and configure and deliver technical solutions to meet individual client needs. The role combines programming expertise with a deep understanding of the insurance/insurtech space, comprising engineering, sales, and client success.

Successful candidates will join an established and growing team to meet the demands of growth, working collaboratively with Engineering, Product and Commercial teams. You will be responsible for proof of value / pilot projects that are pivotal to our growth strategy.

Please note, this is a hybrid role with 2-3 days per week based at our HQ or at client site (City of London).

About the role

  • Lead the analysis of prospective partners’ and clients’ business requirements, translating them into robust technical solutions using our domain-specific, spreadsheet-like functional programming language, Brossa

  • Manage and mentor a team of Forward Deployed Engineers to meet performance goals, providing regular feedback, coaching, and support for professional development.

  • Manage and develop a team, setting clear objectives, providing regular feedback, and supporting their growth within the team.

  • Own the design, configuration and delivery of formal specifications for insurance products across multiple lines of business (e.g. marine, aviation, political violence)

  • Act as a trusted technical partner to clients, shaping solutions that align with their strategic goals and constraints

  • Collaborate closely with product, engineering and commercial teams to customise and configure the platform for client needs

  • Build and manage platform integrations, ensuring reliable delivery and ongoing technical support

  • Demonstrate product value and technical credibility to senior internal and client stakeholders

About you

  • You have a strong foundation in programming and are comfortable working with domain-specific or functional languages

  • Proven experience leading and developing teams with a track record of building high-performing cultures and growing talent into more senior roles.

  • You communicate clearly and confidently with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including client leadership

  • You thrive in a fast-changing scale-up environment and are comfortable operating with ambiguity and autonomy

  • You are solutions-driven, with a continuous improvement mindset towards systems and processes

  • You have excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, and enjoy tackling complex, real-world problems

  • You are able to learn new platforms and domains quickly and apply that knowledge effectively

We especially want to hear from you if you have

  • Collaborative skills with an emphasis on product quality.

  • Experience in insurtech, insurance or related industries.

  • Strong problem-solving skills.

  • Experience in a distributed work environment.

description_html:
Eine starke IT entsteht dort, wo unterschiedliche Stärken zusammenkommen und gemeinsam pragmatische Lösungen schaffen.

Aufgaben

Infrastruktur & Systeme

  • Sie übernehmen die Verantwortung für die Verwaltung, Betreuung und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung unserer gesamten IT-Infrastruktur.
  • Die Administration unserer virtuellen Server-, Host- und VMware-Umgebungen liegt ebenso in Ihrem Aufgabenbereich wie die Betreuung unserer Netzwerk- und Firewall-Infrastruktur auf Basis von Unifi, Aruba und Fortigate.
  • Sie verwalten und überwachen unsere Backupstruktur mit Veeam und sorgen dafür, dass unsere Systeme zuverlässig abgesichert und verfügbar bleiben.
  • Darüber hinaus betreuen Sie unsere Telefonanlage, die Mobilfunkverwaltung sowie weitere zentrale IT-Systeme im Unternehmensalltag.

Modern Workplace & Automatisierung

  • Die Administration unserer Microsoft-365-Umgebung inklusive Intune, Entra ID, Geräteverwaltung, Softwareverwaltung und Mail Security gehört ebenfalls zu Ihrem Verantwortungsbereich.
  • Sie betreuen unsere Active-Directory-Umgebung, übernehmen die Benutzerverwaltung und stellen sicher, dass Berechtigungen und Gruppenrichtlinien zuverlässig gepflegt werden.
  • Mit Hilfe von PowerShell sowie Power Automate und Power Apps automatisieren Sie Prozesse und tragen dazu bei, Abläufe effizienter und nachhaltiger zu gestalten.
  • Gemeinsam mit Kolleg:innen aus unterschiedlichen Fachbereichen und innerhalb des IT-Teams entwickeln Sie praxisnahe Lösungen, die den Arbeitsalltag vereinfachen und technische Prozesse verbessern.

Support & Zusammenarbeit

  • Sie arbeiten eng mit Ihren Teamkolleg:innen zusammen, bringen eigene Ideen ein und unterstützen sich gegenseitig bei unterschiedlichen technischen Herausforderungen und Projekten.
  • Sie übernehmen den 1st- und 2nd-Level-Support für unsere Mitarbeitenden, analysieren IT-Störungen und sorgen für schnelle sowie verständliche Lösungen.
  • Dabei helfen Sie Kolleg:innen dabei, sicher und effizient mit Hard- und Software zu arbeiten und stehen bei technischen Fragen unterstützend zur Seite.
  • Sie dokumentieren relevante IT-Prozesse und unterstützen bei der Einführung neuer Systeme und Anwendungen.
  • Darüber hinaus begleiten Sie Mitarbeitende bei Veränderungen im digitalen Arbeitsumfeld und unterstützen dabei, neue Lösungen verständlich und praxisnah im Alltag zu etablieren.

Qualifikation

  • Sie interessieren sich für moderne IT-Lösungen und haben bereits Erfahrung im Bereich Systemadministration, Infrastruktur oder IT-Support gesammelt – ganz gleich, ob durch eine Ausbildung, ein Studium oder einen vergleichbaren beruflichen Weg.
  • In Themen wie Microsoft 365, Netzwerke, Serverumgebungen oder Endpoint-Management fühlen Sie sich zuhause und haben Freude daran, technische Lösungen praxisnah weiterzuentwickeln.
  • Sie arbeiten strukturiert und eigenständig, schätzen aber gleichzeitig den Austausch im Team und unterstützen Kolleg zuverlässig im gemeinsamen Arbeitsalltag.Die Zusammenarbeit mit Mitarbeitenden macht Ihnen Freude und Sie verstehen es, technische Themen verständlich, lösungsorientiert und ohne komplizierte Fachsprache zu vermitteln.
  • Sie behalten auch bei mehreren parallelen Themen den Überblick und gehen Herausforderungen pragmatisch sowie verantwortungsvoll an.
  • Idealerweise bringen Sie bereits Erfahrung mit Technologien wie VMware, Intune, Active Directory, Veeam oder PowerShell mit und haben Interesse daran, bestehende Prozesse weiterzuentwickeln oder zu automatisieren.
  • Zusammenhalt, Wertschätzung, Begeisterung, Commitment, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit sind Werte, die für Sie nicht nur gut klingen, sondern die Sie auch im täglichen Miteinander wichtig finden.

Benefits

  • Sie übernehmen wiederkehrende administrative Aufgaben rund um Active Directory sowie unsere Netzwerk-, Telefonie- und Mobilfunksysteme und stimmen komplexere Themen mit Ihren Kolleg:innen oder externen IT-Partnern ab.
  • Sie dokumentieren Störungen und Lösungen und helfen dabei, Anleitungen und wiederkehrende Abläufe so festzuhalten, dass sie auch für andere verständlich und nachvollziehbar sind.

title: Electrician (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Sereact GmbH
description_html:
Who We Are:

We build the intelligence that lets robots sense, reason, and act in the real world—moving beyond the lab and into everyday industrial settings like warehouses and factories. Our technology closes the automation gaps that traditional systems can’t solve. We are on a mission to redefine how physical work gets done, and we’re looking for curious, bold thinkers to help shape the future of robotics with us.

Overview:

We are looking for a hands-on electrician or automation technician to support the build, installation, and optimization of our robotic systems. You will be responsible for wiring, testing, and commissioning electrical components both in our lab and on-site. You will collaborate closely with mechanical and software teams to ensure seamless system integration, resolve technical issues, and implement improvements across new and existing systems.

Your Responsibilities:

Installation & Integration

  • Build and wire electrical systems for robotic applications, including cabinets and field wiring. 

  • Support system commissioning in the robotics lab and at customer locations.  

  • Work closely with mechanical and software engineers to ensure correct system integration.  

  • Implement technical improvements and modifications based on project feedback.  

  • Diagnose and resolve electrical faults during development and deployment.

Qualifications:

Education and Experience

  • Completed technical training (e.g. State-certified Technician in Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering, or Automation) or a comparable vocational qualification (e.g. Electrician, Control Cabinet Builder, Electrical Master)

  • Certified to perform electrical work (Elektrofachkraft – EFK)

  • Relevant professional experience in automation or robotics preferred

  • Willingness to travel: ≈ 25-50%

Skills

  • Experience with electrical installations, control systems, sensors, and actuators  

  • Hands-on mentality and technical craftsmanship

  • Basic knowledge of EPLAN/Splan is a plus

  • Valid Class B driver’s license (EU)

Our interview plan:

  • Application

  • Take‑home assignment: You’ll work on a short, role‑relevant task with clear instructions and a deadline.

  • Cultural fit interview (40 min): A conversation about how you work, what motivates you, and what you’re looking for. Expect CV highlights, your “why,” and time for your questions.

  • Technical fit interview (45 min): A deeper dive into your skills and problem‑solving approach for this role.

  • On‑site visit: Meet the team in our office and collaborate on a real challenge similar to the work you’d do here. You’ll also meet a founder; we aim to give you a clear feel for the role and environment.

What We Offer:

  • Wellpass (gym membership)  

  • Flexible working hours  

  • Option to work from home when needed  

  • A motivated team and an open corporate culture  

  • Competitive compensation and excellent career development opportunities

title: Business Development Representative - SMB (English-speaking)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Secfix
description_html:
Remote from the UK or Germany. English (CEFR C2 level) is essential.

At Secfix, we’re at the forefront of automating security compliance in Europe. We help companies get and stay ISO 27001, GDPR, TISAX, and SOC 2 fast and easy and reduce hundreds of hours of manual work.

Secfix is run by a 100% remote team with hubs in Munich, Berlin and London. We’re a high-performing team looking for passionate, execution-focused, owners to help us automate security and compliance for modern companies and become the European compliance automation leader. We’re backed by top VCs, including Octopus Ventures, Neosfer (Commerzbank), founders of Signavio and many more business angels.

About The Role:

We’re hiring a BDR SMB to further expand our SMB segment in the UKI & Benelux region.

You will join our Go-To-Market team and work alongside other team members focused on SMB accounts. Together, you will drive and scale our SMB motion through consistent, high-volume outbound execution.

Your main mission: build pipeline and generate high-quality opportunities for Sales. You will work closely with GTM Leadership and Account Executives to ensure a steady flow of well-qualified meetings.

This is a high-energy, execution-focused role. It is ideal for someone early in their sales career who wants to grow fast, take ownership early, and prove themselves in a performance-driven environment.

What You'll Do:

You will play a key role in building predictable SMB pipeline.

We don’t micromanage — we give context, trust, and ownership. You’ll have the freedom to test, iterate, and improve how we approach SMB expansion, while being fully accountable for your results.

You will:

  • Own your dedicated SMB territory in the UKI & Benelux region

  • Build net-new pipeline through high-volume outbound execution

  • Execute structured multi-channel outreach: cold calling, email outreach, LinkedIn

  • Consistently maintain high activity levels and daily outreach targets

  • Run discovery and qualification calls with SMB prospects

  • Hand over well-qualified opportunities to Account Executives

  • Maintain clean CRM hygiene and pipeline tracking in HubSpot

  • Identify small automation improvements to increase efficiency

  • Use feedback and data to continuously improve outreach performance

This is a numbers-driven hunter role. Success is measured by pipeline generated, meetings booked, activity levels, and targets achieved.

About You:

You are ambitious, resilient, and highly execution-driven. You are not afraid to pick up the phone — repeatedly.

You bring:

  • 1+ years of experience (internship, working student, or full-time) in a fast-paced environment (startup, consulting, sales, business development, etc.)

  • A completed commercial training (equivalent to e.g. “kaufmännische Ausbildung”) or a Bachelor’s degree

  • A strong ownership mindset — you take responsibility for hitting targets

  • Excellent English skills (CEFR C2 level)

  • Confidence in cold calling and proactive outbound outreach

  • High energy, persistence, and comfort with rejection

  • A structured and disciplined working style

  • A data-driven mindset and comfort working with KPIs

You see this role as the foundation for building a long-term career in Sales.

Nice-to-have:

  • First experience in Business Development or Sales

  • Exposure to B2B SaaS

  • Familiarity with tools like HubSpot or LinkedIn Sales Navigator

  • Experience in an early-stage startup (Series A–B)

  • First knowledge of the target market UKI / Benelux

What We Offer:

  • Remote Work: 100% remote work with a virtual office in Gather.

  • Competitive Salary: Industry-competitive local salaries. We pay local rates that are at or above the market. We share this philosophy with GitLab.

  • Equity: Generous equity package – we’re all owners of Secfix and beneficiaries of our collective success.

  • Mentorship: We are backed by top VCs and accelerators and have direct access to world-class mentors.

  • Development Budget: €1,000 annual personal development budget.

  • Home office Budget: Home office budget and access to co-working spaces.

  • Holidays: 26 days holiday + local public holidays.

  • Annual Retreat: Annual retreat to build connections and inspire ideas (last year we’re headed to Costa Brava!).

  • Company Events: Company-wide events to build relationships and have some fun!

  • Tech Equipment: Latest tech equipment (MacBook, headphones).

Interview Process:

  • Intro call with Talent team

  • Cold call with hiring manager

  • Take-home assignment

  • 60–90 min – Assignment review & interview with GTM Lead

  • 45 min – Final interview with Co-Founders

Please note: We are an equal-opportunity employer and remote-only company. At this time, we can support hiring only within EU time zones. We work in sync using Gather as our virtual office. As a small fast-growing company, we believe in the need for an in-sync component of daily communication and therefore cannot support 100% asynchronous work. Read more about our Remote Culture here.

This isn’t your regular job. Almedia is a place where those who want to push harder can accelerate their careers faster than anywhere else. We’re aiming to become Germany’s second bootstrapped unicorn. Almedia is already Europe’s #3 fastest-growing company in 2025 (FT1000).

We are building the future of marketing by rewarding our community of over 80 million users for engaging with our advertisers’ products. We are offering a new way to acquire users for the biggest companies in the world.

Bei Almedia wirst du:

  • Verantwortung ab Tag eins: Du übernimmst früh wichtige Creator Partnerships und gestaltest aktiv mit, wie wir wachsen.

  • Impact wird belohnt: Wir suchen Menschen, die mehr bewegen wollen. Dein Einsatz, deine Ergebnisse und deine Entwicklung zahlen sich bei uns aus.

  • Ein Team mit Drive: Ambitionierte Menschen, hohes Tempo und klare Verantwortung. Und das in einem Umfeld, das dich jeden Tag besser macht.

  • Zusammen entsteht Momentum: Wir arbeiten fünf Tage pro Woche gemeinsam im Büro – für schnelle Entscheidungen, kreative Ideen und die Energie, die starke Partnerschaften brauchen.

Gehaltsspanne: 55.000 bis 65.000 € pro Jahr

Was du machst 🎯

Du verantwortest bei Almedia den gesamten Creator-Partnership-Prozess. Vom Finden der richtigen Creator über den Deal bis zur erfolgreichen Kampagnen-Performance.

  • Creator Sourcing: Du identifizierst vielversprechende Creator auf Instagram und YouTube, sprichst sie gezielt an und baust langfristige Beziehungen auf.

  • Deal Making: Du führst Verhandlungen eigenständig und bringst Deals sicher zum Abschluss. Von Preisen und Deliverables bis hin zu den Verträgen.

  • Campaign Management: Du steuerst Kampagnen von Anfang bis Ende und stellst sicher, dass der Content pünktlich, hochwertig und markenkonform live geht.

  • Performance: Du analysierst die Ergebnisse, erkennst Potenziale und entwickelst erfolgreiche Creator Partnerships kontinuierlich weiter.

Dein Alltag 💡

  • Du entdeckst Creator-Potenzial: Du recherchierst proaktiv und identifizierst Creators, die perfekt zu unserer Brand und unseren Zielen passen.

  • Du baust echte Partnerschaften auf: Von der ersten Ansprache bis zur langfristigen Zusammenarbeit entwickelst du starke Beziehungen zu Creators.

  • Du machst Deals: Du verhandelst direkt mit Creatorn oder Managements und bringst Partnerschaften erfolgreich zum Abschluss.

  • Du steuerst Kampagnen end-to-end: Vom Briefing über die Content-Abstimmung bis zum Go-live und der anschließenden Auswertung liegt der gesamte Prozess bei dir.

  • Du denkst performanceorientiert: Du trackst KPIs wie CPM, CPI und ROAS, erkennst Optimierungspotenziale und setzt Learnings schnell um.

  • Du skalierst unser Creator-Netzwerk: Du pflegst unsere Creator-Datenbank, entwickelst sie weiter und schaffst die Grundlage für nachhaltiges Wachstum.

  • Du arbeitest crossfunktional: Gemeinsam mit Performance Marketing und Creative entwickelst du Kampagnen, die kreativ überzeugen und messbare Ergebnisse liefern.

Was du mitbringst 🌟

  • Du bringst relevante Erfahrung mit: Idealerweise hast du bereits 1 bis 4 Jahre im Influencer Marketing, Creator Management oder einem vergleichbaren Umfeld gearbeitet.

  • Du verstehst die Plattformen: Instagram und YouTube kennst du nicht nur als User. Du verstehst Formate, Trends und weißt, welcher Content wirklich konvertiert.

  • Du kannst verhandeln: Du hast bereits Deals mit Creators oder Managements verhandelt und weißt, wie man starke Partnerschaften aufsetzt.

  • Du denkst datengetrieben: Zahlen helfen dir, Chancen zu erkennen, Entscheidungen zu treffen und Kampagnen gezielt zu optimieren.

  • Du kommunizierst sicher: Dein Deutsch ist fließend in Wort und Schrift, dein Englisch sehr gut.

  • Du hast echten Ownership-Mindset: Du wartest nicht auf den nächsten Auftrag, sondern erkennst selbst, was getan werden muss, und setzt es um.

Nice to have:

  • Du kennst die richtigen Tools: Mit Plattformen wie Upfluence, Modash oder vergleichbaren Creator-Marketing-Tools hast du bereits gearbeitet.

  • Du verstehst Performance: Erfahrung im Performance Marketing oder in der Mobile User Acquisition ist ein starkes Plus.

  • Du bringst ein Netzwerk mit: Du hast bereits gute Kontakte zu Creators, Agenturen oder Managements und kannst darauf aufbauen.

Warum Almedia? 🎁

  • Dein Erfolg ist unser Erfolg: Alle Mitarbeitenden in Berlin erhalten Unternehmensanteile und profitieren damit direkt von unserer gemeinsamen Entwicklung.

  • Wachse mit uns: Werde Teil eines seit Tag eins profitablen Startups und entwickle dich in einem Umfeld weiter, das ambitioniert denkt und schnell wächst.

  • Ein Office, in dem etwas passiert: Unser modernes, voll ausgestattetes Büro liegt mitten in Berlin, ist bestens erreichbar und auf echten Austausch ausgelegt.

  • Benefits, die deinen Alltag besser machen: Freu dich unter anderem auf einen Fahrtkostenzuschuss, Frühstück und Mittagessen, Sprachkurse sowie eine Urban-Sports-Club-Mitgliedschaft.

We believe in fostering talent, evaluating all skill levels during the hiring process, and providing a clear path for growth. Almedia is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate diversity, and encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

title: Marketing Communications Manager (B2B)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Almedia
description_html:
This isn’t your regular job. Almedia is a place where those who want to push harder can accelerate their careers faster than anywhere else. We’re aiming to become Germany’s second bootstrapped unicorn. Almedia is already Europe’s #3 fastest-growing company in 2025 (FT1000).

We are building the future of marketing by rewarding our community of over 80 million users for engaging with our advertisers’ products. We are offering a new way to acquire users for the biggest companies in the world.

At Almedia, you’ll:

  • Own way more, way earlier — you’ll be trusted with responsibility fast.

  • Push harder, get further — this isn’t a 9–5. We highly reward intensity.

  • Join a rare environment — you will work with ambitious high-speed, high-ownership people.

  • Fully present — we’re 5 days a week in the office to build the energising momentum we need.

Salary Range: €55K - €68K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus

We're looking for a Marketing Communications Manager (B2B) who spans brand and growth marketing - someone versatile enough to move across content and product marketing, but with a clear centre of gravity in storytelling and strategic content production. You'll be part of a hybrid team where everyone covers more than one surface, and you'll have real ownership across multiple workstreams from day one to do whatever brings the most impact to reach our company goals.

The core of the job is making Almedia’s expertise and brand impossible to ignore in the space of gaming, advertising, technology, data, consumer apps, scale-ups and growth companies, so we get noticed by partners. That means finding the signal inside a technically complex business, turning it into content that actually moves people and deals, and then making sure it reaches the right personas in the right way. The measure of success is simple: how many more people know about Almedia, and how many stakeholders reach out to us because of our initiatives and the collateral we publish, rather than the other way around.

You'll report to our Global B2B Marketing Lead, work closely with PR and event managers, and collaborate with the growth team and C-Suite to continuously develop the Almedia brand.

What You'll Do 🎯

  • Drive flagship brand campaigns. Own brand campaigns end to end - from identifying the high-impact opportunity and building the story, through to channel rollout and measurement. You decide what gets done, made and why. The standard is that it needs to be worth actioning, not just worth reading.

  • Leverage the team. Find ways to use our 150+ people to source content and amplify the message, without adding to their workload, but making their contributions count.

  • Build and distribute the growth content engine. Develop white papers sourced from our own data, case studies with real customer evidence, a monthly newsletter, and campaign assets for our flagship events, then own how they get out into the world. Identify the right channels, the right timing, and the right formats to make sure what gets made actually gets read. Track whether it's working and adjust.

  • Make sales self-sufficient. Build a product marketing toolkit for Freecash and Link, including messaging, one-pagers, pitch decks, and case studies, so that active deals and existing partnerships use the collateral instead of improvised slides. Track adoption and close the loop with the sales team on what's actually working.

  • Grow Almedia's presence. Turn the work you produce into reputation. The white papers, case studies, and campaign assets you create should be doing double duty, showing up in pitches, feeding into event narratives, and giving Almedia a clear point of view in a crowded market. The goal is that people in our industry know who we are and what we stand for, because the content speaks for itself.

  • Bring stakeholders along. Get internal buy-in for marketing initiatives from people who have other priorities. Whether it's sourcing a customer story from sales, getting a C-Suite perspective into a white paper, or aligning leadership on a campaign direction, you know how to make marketing a team effort without making it someone else's problem.

  • Support event planning and execution. Organise the conferences, sponsorships, and brand activations Almedia shows up to — logistics, booth setup, timelines, vendor coordination.

What Your First 90 Days Look Like

  • Month 1: Learn the product suite, the sales motion, and the content gaps. Audit existing collateral and identify what's missing or not being used. Get onboarded on the brand activities and support planned activations and events with narrative and copy.

  • Month 2: Ship your first white paper or flagship content asset and own its distribution. Conceptualise a brand or growth-focused event.

  • Month 3: Own the growth side of the social and website content calendar. Have a working content calendar in place, and a feedback loop running between you, sales, and leadership on what's resonating. By this point you're running on your own.

What You'll Bring 💡

  • Strategic content thinking. You approach content as a lever, not a deliverable. You ask what outcome a piece needs to drive before you write a word, and you're just as focused on distribution and measurement as you are on the writing itself. You're not here to fill a content calendar, you're here to shift how our market thinks about Almedia.

  • C2-level B2B writing. You can take a complex product or technical concept and produce something a busy CMO would read in full. Long-form assets, white papers, case studies, product one-pagers, come out publish-ready, not draft-ready. You self-edit hard and don't need someone to rewrite your work.

  • Story sourcing instinct. You know how to find the interesting thing inside a business: the data point that reframes a conversation, the customer story that proves the value prop, the internal perspective that hasn't been said publicly yet. You don't wait for a brief to hand you a story.

  • Product marketing fundamentals. You've built or maintained messaging frameworks, value propositions, and sales collateral before. You understand how B2B buyers think and what makes a case study actually useful in a sales conversation versus something that sits in a Notion folder.

  • Project ownership. Complex projects, a website section, a flagship report, a product launch toolkit, run on your calendar, not someone else's. You track dependencies, manage vendors or freelancers when needed, and communicate proactively when something is off track.

description_html:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

We are looking for product leads to shape and drive major product areas within BJAK's AI Neobank app.

This role is for senior product builders who can own direction, execution, product quality and outcomes across multiple workstreams or squads.

 

What You'll Own

  • Lead product direction for major AI Neobank app areas.

  • Define priorities, roadmap, product standards and success metrics across multiple features or squads.

  • Guide PMs, Product Owners, designers and engineers toward clear execution.

  • Work across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel and other financial services.

  • Turn regulatory, operational and business constraints into practical product decisions.

  • Drive launch quality, post-launch learning and continuous improvement.

  • Help build a product culture focused on speed, clarity, user value and honest measurement.


What We're Looking For

  • Strong experience leading digital product areas, not just individual features.

  • Able to balance strategy, execution, UX, data, engineering and business outcomes.

  • Strong judgement on prioritization, trade-offs and product sequencing.

  • Experience leading or mentoring PMs / POs / cross-functional squads is a strong advantage.

  • Comfortable with high ambiguity, fast changes and senior stakeholder pressure.

  • Able to simplify complex financial products into usable journeys.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or regulated products is a strong advantage.


The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Can set direction and still go deep into details.

  • Pushes teams to move faster without lowering product quality.

  • Knows when to simplify, when to scale and when to say no.

  • Can lead through clarity, not bureaucracy.

  • Avoids false claims and understands that product impact usually comes from many iterations and teams.


This Role Is Not For

  • Product leaders who only manage people and meetings.

  • People who cannot go deep into product details.

  • Candidates who are too slow for a high-growth environment.

  • Leaders who push vanity metrics without understanding real user impact.

  • People who need large teams before they can create progress.


Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Germany. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Germany.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Software Engineer - Simulation Platform
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Proxima Fusion GmbH
description_html:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.

  • You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals.

  • Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey.

  • Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Shape the future of Proxima’s simulation platform: imagine and build with us novel solutions for simulation tools that spark joy and reduce time-to-insight

  • Accelerate Stellarator R&D, at the company at its forefront: we work side by side with researchers and engineers; innovation in simulation tools immediately boosts Proxima Fusion’s Stellarator design program

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • As a platform engineer, you will design, develop and maintain next-generation software solutions for stellarator simulation and design, targeted to human and agentic use: our team manages the full platform from automation of large-scale simulation workflows, to cloud-based data storage that keeps everyone in sync, to applications that foster cross-domain collaboration and knowledge discovery, including integration of AI tools where they actually provide leverage

  • As a forward-deployed engineer, you will work together with our researchers to apply our tools to specific use cases: guide users to make the most of the available simulation tooling and proactively co-develop applications that unblock their R&D program

WHO YOU ARE

  • We are seeking a talented software practitioner with a user-first mindset, interested in tackling a diverse mix of challenges: from the optimization of scientific computing workflows to building cloud- and web-based systems for data management, sharing and exploration

  • Proficient in Python; familiarity with one or more of the following is desirable but not required: Pydantic, JAX, full-stack web development (React, TypeScript, FastAPI), cloud services and cloud-based applications; data management systems

  • You enjoy staying up to date with current software development best practices and tools, e.g. agentic development or modern data pipelines and scheduling solutions

  • You enjoy diving into new problems with a continuous learning attitude, absorbing relevant domain knowledge in a dynamic start-up environment

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30-45 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)

  • CEO call (30 min)


*This role sits at "L2" of our framework, please inquire during the recruitment process for further information.

At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.

Alpha will be the first stellarator to demonstrate net energy. Achieving this milestone requires building a deeply coupled machine, where plasma, magnets, structures, cryogenics, and heating work at the edge of each discipline’s capability. You will own a selected set of the models, stretching over domains, e.g. microwave physics to plasma radiation.These models will be used by the design team to compute load cases, assess system-level tradeoffs, perform numerical optimization, and simulate the whole machine as a single system. You will own these models end-to-end, from definitions of inputs and outputs, to implementation correctness, and software efficiency.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Identify and implement the simulators. Depending on the simulation needs, you will implement a simulator from scratch or wrap an existing tool into our platform, and make sure the model is properly interfaced with our codebase.

  • Co-define the input and output interfaces. Work together with the engineering teams to update the data model for input and output to ensure it captures correctly the relevant design specifications.

  • Ensure correctness. Ensure simulation pipelines are tested, verified, validated and work correctly as the design evolves. Where needed, help scoping and contribute to validation in hardware tests.

  • Exercise the models. Support the integrated design team with dedicated studies to inform design tradeoffs.

  • Expose simulators as a service to humans and agents. Create dashboard, online tools, and interactive reports to visualize model prediction and uncertainties and explore the model behaviour, that can be easily used by the entire Alpha design team.

  • Your knowledge ranges across physics, geometry, and numerical methods. You feel comfortable jumping into the complex 3D geometry of a stellarator and the many physics phenomena happening in a stellarator.
